/wondrous-items:armblade: A warforged attunes by holding this one-handed melee weapon against their forearm throughout attunement. It remains inseparable while attuned. Extend or retract it as a bonus action; when extended, wield it as a held weapon, but that hand cannot serve other purposes.
/wondrous-items:bead-of-nourishment: Dissolve the bead on your tongue to gain the nourishment of one day's rations.
/wondrous-items:bottle-of-boundless-coff: The bottle produces warm coffee and accepts no other liquid. Roll a d20 each time you drink: on a 1, it stops dispensing for one hour. Coffee poured out disappears immediately.
/wondrous-items:cast-off-armor: You can remove this armor as an action.
/wondrous-items:cleansing-stone: Touch this one-foot-diameter stone and use an action to clean dirt and grime from yourself and your clothing.
/wondrous-items:clockwork-amulet: While wearing it, substitute a 10 on the d20 for an attack roll. This property recharges at dawn.
/wondrous-items:cuddly-strixhaven-mascot: As an action, attach the toy to an arm, shoulder, or leg for one hour; an action removes it early. While carrying it, choose before rolling to gain advantage on a save against or to end fear. A successful save expends this benefit until you finish a long rest.
/wondrous-items:ear-horn-of-hearing: Holding the horn to your ear suppresses deafness and allows normal hearing.
/wondrous-items:ersatz-eye: This artificial eye replaces a missing eye and provides normal vision. Only its wearer can remove it while embedded.
/wondrous-items:hat-of-vermin: The hat has 3 charges and regains all at dawn. Spend one charge and an action, speaking its command word, to summon a bat, frog, or rat in the hat. It is uncontrolled and neither friendly nor hostile; it flees, disappearing after one hour or at 0 hit points.
/wondrous-items:horn-of-silent-alarm: The horn has 4 charges and regains 1d4 at dawn. Use an action to blow it; only one chosen creature within 600 feet hears it, provided that creature is not deafened.
/wondrous-items:instrument-of-illusions: While playing, create obviously unreal, silent, harmless visual effects within 5 feet of the instrument, or 15 feet if you are a bard. They end when you stop playing.
/wondrous-items:lantern-of-tracking: Burns one pint of oil for 6 hours, shedding bright light 30 feet and dim light another 30 feet. Its fixed creature type is rolled on its table. The flame turns green within 300 feet of that type, without revealing its location.
/wondrous-items:masquerade-tattoo: Attune by holding the needle against your skin; it becomes the tattoo, reverting to a needle when attunement ends. As a bonus action, change its color, pattern, or position; it remains visibly a tattoo. Once per dawn, use an action to cast Disguise Self; its disguise has DC 13 to discern.
/wondrous-items:medal-of-the-horizonback: When an attack would hit you, use your reaction while wearing the medal and seeing the attacker to gain +5 AC through the start of your next turn, including against that attack. Afterward the medal loses its magic.
/wondrous-items:medal-of-the-wetlands: Use an action to trace the medal's edge and ignore the extra movement cost of difficult terrain for one hour. The medal then becomes nonmagical.
/wondrous-items:moodmark-paint: A jar marks one creature; applying it takes one minute. For eight hours the marks reflect emotions and their main source. A viewer can read these with a DC 10 Wisdom (Insight) check; a dark elf has advantage.
/wondrous-items:orb-of-direction: While holding the orb on the Material Plane, use an action to learn which direction is north.
/wondrous-items:orb-of-time: While holding the orb on the Material Plane, use an action to learn whether it is morning, afternoon, evening, or night outside.
/wondrous-items:pipe-of-smoke-monsters: While smoking, use an action to shape exhaled smoke into one creature that fits inside a one-foot cube. The shape dissipates into ordinary smoke after a few seconds.
/wondrous-items:pot-of-awakening: Grow an ordinary shrub in this 10-pound pot for 30 days to create an awakened shrub. The pot breaks; the shrub is friendly and does nothing without your commands.
/wondrous-items:prosthetic-limb: Replaces a lost limb and functions as the original. Attach or detach it as an action; it cannot be removed against your will and detaches upon death.
/wondrous-items:scribes-pen: Write on any surface, choosing visible or invisible writing. A creature with the Mark of Scribing always sees it and can use an action to reveal invisible writing to everyone. Writing on a nonconstruct creature fades after seven days.
/wondrous-items:shiftweave: The clothing stores up to five outfits. While wearing it, speak its command word as a bonus action to switch designs. It remains clothing and does not gain any magical properties of clothing it imitates.
/wondrous-items:spellwrought-tattoo: Press the needle to your skin and speak its command word to apply a tattoo holding one spell of up to 5th level. Cast that spell without material components; the tattoo glows during casting and duration, then vanishes when the spell ends. Spell level determines rarity, ability modifier, save DC and attack bonus as shown in the table.
/wondrous-items:staff-of-flowers: The staff has 10 charges and regains 1d6 + 4 at dawn. Spend one charge and an action to grow a harmless ordinary flower on the staff or in soil within 5 feet. If the last charge is spent, roll a d20; on 1 the staff becomes petals and is lost.
/wondrous-items:tankard-of-plenty: The tankard has 3 charges, all restored at dawn. Grasp its handle and speak the command word to spend one charge and fill it with three pints of dwarven ale.
/wondrous-items:unbreakable-arrow: The arrow cannot be broken except within an Antimagic Field.
/wondrous-items:walloping-ammunition: A creature struck must succeed on a DC 10 Strength saving throw or fall prone.
/wondrous-items:wand-of-scowls: The wand has 3 charges, restored at dawn. Spend one as an action to target a visible humanoid within 30 feet; a failed DC 10 Charisma save forces a scowl for one minute. When the last charge is spent, roll a d20; on 1 it becomes a Wand of Smiles.
/wondrous-items:alchemy-jug: This 12-pound jug produces a chosen listed liquid after an action; uncork it with another action and pour up to 2 gallons per minute. The table gives each daily maximum. After choosing a liquid, it cannot produce another or exceed that maximum until dawn.
/wondrous-items:all-purpose-tool: An artificer can transform this tool into any artisan tool as an action and is proficient with it. While held, it adds its rarity-based bonus to artificer spell attacks and save DCs. Once per dawn, use an action to select an unknown cantrip from any class; for eight hours it counts as an artificer cantrip for you.
/wondrous-items:arcane-grimoire: Use as a wizard spellcasting focus and spellbook. While held, it adds its rarity-based bonus to wizard spell attacks and save DCs; Arcane Recovery restores one additional spell-slot level.
/wondrous-items:armor-of-weightlessness: The armor has 5 charges and regains 1d4 + 1 at dawn. While wearing it, use a bonus action to cast Jump on yourself for 1 charge or Levitate on yourself for 2.
/wondrous-items:balloon-pack: Wearer deploys the balloon as an action to gain Levitate for 10 minutes without concentration, or as a reaction while falling to gain Feather Fall. When the spell ends, descend gently up to 60 feet, then fall if unsupported. Recharge for one hour in an elemental air node before reuse.
/wondrous-items:blood-of-the-lycanthrope: Drinking this potion removes lycanthropy imposed by a lycanthrope bite or similar effect.
/wondrous-items:bloodwell-vial: Attune with drops of your blood; the vial cannot be opened while attuned. Use it as a spellcasting focus while worn or held, gaining its rarity-based bonus to sorcerer spell attacks and save DCs. Once per dawn, regain 5 sorcery points when spending any Hit Dice to heal while carrying it.
/wondrous-items:brooch-of-living-essence: While worn, effects detecting your creature type perceive you as humanoid, and those detecting alignment perceive neutral.
/wondrous-items:circlet-of-human-perfect: The attuned wearer becomes an attractive human of average height and weight, with appearance chosen by the circlet. Other than size, statistics and racial traits remain unchanged, as do carried or worn items. Removing it ends the transformation.
/wondrous-items:cursed-luckstone: Once per dawn, gain advantage on an ability check while carrying it. Attunement curses you until Remove Curse or similar magic; the stone returns to your pocket or pack if discarded. After using its benefit, your next two ability checks have disadvantage.
/wondrous-items:dragon-vessel: Once per dawn, speak the command word as a bonus action to fill the empty vessel. Slumbering: ale, olive oil, healing potion, or climbing potion; Stirring adds mead, fire breath, or greater healing; Wakened adds wine, flying, or superior healing; Ascendant adds whiskey, supreme healing, or dragon’s majesty. Created potions lose magic after 24 hours.
/wondrous-items:dragon-touched-focus: Slumbering grants initiative advantage and serves as a spell focus. Stirring adds a dragon-family effect: chromatic adds 1d6 to one qualifying elemental spell damage roll; gem teleports 15 feet after a slotted spell; metallic uses a reaction to give a visible creature within 30 feet save advantage. Wakened adds family spells, each once per dawn. Ascendant can treat one spell of 1st level or higher as cast with a 9th-level slot once per dawn.
/wondrous-items:dust-of-corrosion: One use: scatter as an action in a 10-foot cube extending from you. Nonmagical ferrous metal objects and surfaces corrode to useless dust. Creatures partly or wholly made of ferrous metal make a DC 13 Constitution save, taking 4d8 necrotic damage, half on success.
/wondrous-items:eldritch-claw-tattoo: Attune by pressing its needle to your skin. Your unarmed strikes count as magical against resistance and immunity and gain +1 to attack and damage. Once per dawn, use a bonus action to empower it for one minute: melee weapon and unarmed attacks reach 15 feet and deal an extra 1d6 force damage on a hit.
/wondrous-items:feywild-shard: Attach to or detach from a Tiny object as an action; it falls off when attunement ends. Hold or wear as a focus. When using Metamagic on a spell, you may roll on the Wild Magic Surge table; resulting spells gain no Metamagic and require no concentration, lasting their full duration. Non-Wild Magic sorcerers can use this property once per dawn.
/wondrous-items:goggles-of-object-readin: While worn, gain advantage on Intelligence (Arcana) checks to learn about a visible creature or object. Cast Identify once per dawn.
/wondrous-items:guild-signet: The ring has 3 charges and regains 1d3 at dawn. While worn, spend one charge to cast its guild-associated spell, save DC 13; see the guild spell table.
/wondrous-items:helm-of-underwater-actio: While wearing the helm, breathe underwater, gain darkvision 60 feet, and gain a swimming speed of 30 feet.
/wondrous-items:inquisitives-goggles: Requires the Mark of Finding. Add your Hunter’s Intuition die to Wisdom (Insight) checks. Examine an object and make a Wisdom (Perception) check, DC 13 plus days since the last living creature touched it; success reveals that creature’s species and lets you immediately target it with Imprint Prey.
/wondrous-items:living-gloves: Wear throughout attunement to bond. Choose Sleight of Hand, thieves’ tools, one artisan tool, or one instrument; gain proficiency and double proficiency bonus on checks using it. The gloves cannot be removed and attunement cannot be voluntarily ended; a curse-ending spell ends attunement and permits removal.
/wondrous-items:mask-of-the-beast: The mask has 3 charges, restored at dawn. While wearing it, spend one charge and an action to cast Animal Friendship.
/wondrous-items:moon-sickle: While holding this weapon, apply its rarity-based bonus to its attack and damage rolls and to druid and ranger spell attacks and save DCs. It is a focus for those spells. When casting a healing spell while holding it, add 1d4 to the hit points restored.
/wondrous-items:night-caller: Blow in darkness or under the night sky to cast Animate Dead, affecting a target under up to 10 feet of soft earth; a buried target takes one minute to emerge. After animating a creature, this cannot animate another for seven days. Once per 24 hours, blow it to reassert control over one or two creatures it animated.
/wondrous-items:pixie-dust: As an action, sprinkle this single-use dust on yourself or a visible creature within 5 feet. It gains a 30-foot flying speed and hover for one minute; if airborne when it ends, it lands safely on its feet.
/wondrous-items:potion-of-advantage: Within one hour after drinking, gain advantage on one ability check, attack roll, or saving throw of your choice.
/wondrous-items:potion-of-psionic-fortit: For one hour after drinking, gain advantage on saves to avoid or end the charmed or stunned conditions on yourself.
/wondrous-items:propeller-helm: While worn, cast Levitate without components; the propeller makes a loud noise until the spell ends. Each time it ends there is a 50 percent chance the helm permanently loses its magic.
/wondrous-items:quandrix-primer: The book has 3 charges and regains 1d3 at dawn. While holding it, spend a charge after rolling an Intelligence (Arcana or Nature) check to add 1d4. Study after a long rest to choose a 1st-level druid or wizard spell; cast it once without a slot before your next long rest while holding the book, using Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma.
/wondrous-items:ring-of-puzzlers-wit: The ring has 3 charges and regains 1d4 − 1 at dawn. Spend a charge to gain advantage on an Intelligence check.
/wondrous-items:rings-of-shared-sufferin: These rings form a linked pair. A bearer with the Mark of Sentinel can use a bonus action to link to the other wearer: that creature takes half its damage and you take the rest, regardless of range. End the link with a bonus action or by removing either ring. No creature can attune to more than one.
/wondrous-items:rod-of-the-pact-keeper: While held, add its rarity-based bonus to warlock spell attacks and save DCs. Once per long rest, use an action while holding it to regain one warlock spell slot.
/wondrous-items:seeker-dart: Whisper its command and throw it at a previously seen target within 120 feet. It follows a clear path around corners and through openings at least one inch wide; otherwise its magic is wasted. The target makes a DC 16 Dexterity save or takes 1d4 piercing plus 3d4 lightning damage. The dart then becomes ordinary.
/wondrous-items:sentinel-shield: While holding the shield, gain advantage on initiative rolls and Wisdom (Perception) checks.
/wondrous-items:shield-1-2-3: While holding it, add its rarity-based magic bonus to AC in addition to the shield’s normal AC bonus.
/wondrous-items:skyblinder-staff: This quarterstaff gives +1 to weapon attack and damage rolls and, while held, +1 to spell attack rolls. When a visible flying creature within 30 feet attacks you, use a reaction to impose disadvantage; it must make a DC 15 Constitution save or be blinded until its next turn starts.
/wondrous-items:soul-coin: Each coin contains a soul and has 3 charges. Spend one as an action for 1d10 temporary hit points or a truthful brief telepathic answer from the soul. Remove Curse or spending all charges frees the soul and destroys the coin. A nonevil bearer carrying more coins than their Constitution modifier has disadvantage on attacks, checks, and saves. The coin has AC 19, hit points equal to remaining charges, and is immune to damage except from hellfire weapons or infernal war machine furnaces.
/wondrous-items:staff-of-the-adder: Speak its command as a bonus action to animate or restore its snake head; animation lasts one minute. Its proficient melee attack has 5-foot reach, deals 1d6 piercing, and requires a DC 15 Constitution save against 3d6 poison. The animate head has AC 15 and 20 HP; at 0 HP the staff is destroyed. Otherwise it regains lost HP on reverting.
/wondrous-items:storm-boomerang: Thrown range 60/120; javelin proficiency applies. A hit deals 1d4 bludgeoning plus 3d4 thunder, and requires a DC 10 Constitution save against stun until the target’s next turn ends. A miss returns it to your hand. After dealing thunder damage, the thunder and stun properties require one hour in an elemental air node to recharge.
/wondrous-items:wand-of-entangle: The wand has 7 charges and regains 1d6 + 1 at dawn. Spend one as an action to cast Entangle (save DC 13). Spending the last charge destroys it on a d20 roll of 1.
/wondrous-items:wheel-of-wind-and-water: Mounted on an elemental galleon or airship, it allows a creature with the Mark of Storm to control the bound elemental telepathically. On a mundane sailing ship, a bearer with the mark can create ideal conditions and increase speed by 5 mph.
/wondrous-items:wingwear: The suit has 3 charges, restored after one hour in an elemental air node. While wearing it, spend one as a bonus action to fly at 30 feet until landing. At each turn’s end lose 5 feet of altitude; if you did not fly 30 feet horizontally, altitude drops to zero and you land or fall.
/wondrous-items:acheron-blade: This sword grants +1 to attack and damage, and immunity to effects that turn undead while carried. Once per dusk, use an action while holding it for 1d4 + 4 temporary HP. Once per dusk on a hit, impose disadvantage on the target’s next save before your next turn ends, unless it is immune to frightened.
/wondrous-items:astral-shard: Attach to or detach from a Tiny object as an action; it falls off when attunement ends. Hold or wear it as a spellcasting focus. Immediately after casting a spell with Metamagic while holding or wearing it, teleport to an unoccupied visible space within 30 feet.
/wondrous-items:badge-of-the-watch: While worn, gain +2 AC if not using a shield. If more than 5 feet away from you for over one minute, it returns to a surface within 5 feet of Waterdeep’s Open Lord. While holding it, the Open Lord knows your location on the same plane and can end your attunement by touching it as an action.
/wondrous-items:bell-branch: A held spellcasting focus with 3 charges, regaining 1d3 at dawn. Spend one as a bonus action to detect listed creature types within 60 feet without total cover, identifying types by tone; or spend one as an action to cast Protection from Evil and Good.
/wondrous-items:bow-of-conflagration: Hits deal an extra 1d6 fire damage. A flammable nonmagical object hit ignites and takes 1d6 fire damage at the start of each of your turns until extinguished with an action.
/wondrous-items:breastplate-of-balance: The armor has 4 charges and regains 1d4 at dawn. Spend one as a reaction when you or a visible creature within 60 feet is about to roll a d20 with advantage or disadvantage to cancel either. Spend two as a bonus action to cast Lesser Restoration.
/wondrous-items:cauldron-of-plenty: Stir water for one minute to produce hot nourishing stew for four people per gallon. It holds 30 gallons, weighs 50 pounds, and makes stew three times per dawn.
/wondrous-items:claw-of-the-wyrm-rune: While displayed, gain resistance to damage from dragon breath. Three times per dawn, use an action to target a dragon within 30 feet; on a failed DC 15 Constitution save it is vulnerable to all damage until your next turn ends. Alternatively work for eight hours to destroy the claw and create a fixed 100-foot-radius ward where dragons have disadvantage on saves and flying speed at most 10 feet.
/wondrous-items:crown-of-the-wrath-bring: When your attack hits while wearing the crown, spend and roll an unspent Hit Die to add that much psychic damage. Once per dawn use an action to cast Fear (DC 15), lasting one minute without concentration.
/wondrous-items:deck-of-oracles: After a long rest, spend 10 minutes consulting the cards and record a d20 roll. Within eight hours, use a reaction immediately after a creature within 60 feet makes an attack, check, or save to substitute that number. While holding the deck, cast Divination once per dawn.
/wondrous-items:devotees-censer: This magic flail is a holy symbol and deals an extra 1d8 radiant damage on a hit. Once per dawn, speak its command as a bonus action to release incense in a 10-foot radius for one minute; at the start of each of your turns, you and other creatures in the cloud regain 1d4 HP.
/wondrous-items:donjons-sundering-sphere: Attune by attaching it to a nonmagical melee weapon, making the weapon +1 to attack and damage until attunement ends. While wielding it, gain advantage on saves against involuntary planar or extradimensional travel. Once per dawn on a hit, force a DC 16 Charisma save or banish the target to a harmless demiplane until its next turn ends.
/wondrous-items:duplicitous-manuscript: A disguised wizard spellbook and focus containing the listed illusion spells. It has 3 charges, regaining 1d3 at dawn. Spend one and one minute studying to exchange a prepared wizard spell for an illusion spell in the book, or spend one as a reaction to impose disadvantage on a visible creature’s investigation or save against your illusion spell.
/wondrous-items:elixir-of-health: Drinking cures diseases and removes blinded, deafened, paralyzed, and poisoned conditions.
/wondrous-items:feather-of-diatryma-summ: Use an action to speak the command and throw it into a Large space within 5 feet, summoning a friendly, obedient diatryma for up to six hours. It uses axe beak statistics but deals piercing damage, can serve as a mount, and reverts at 0 HP or when dismissed by action while touching it. Recharges seven days after reverting.
/wondrous-items:flying-chariot: Riders and pulling creatures gain +1 AC; the chariot flies if pulled by flying creatures. Riders have half cover and mount or dismount for 5 feet of movement. Speed equals the slowest puller; multiple pullers share initiative and take the same action.
/wondrous-items:gamblers-blade: Choose a +1 to +3 attack and damage bonus, changeable at dawn; take the corresponding penalty on death saves. Attunement curses you and makes you unwilling to part with it until Remove Curse or similar magic breaks the curse.
/wondrous-items:ghost-lantern: While holding it, command its spirit as a bonus action to shed bright light 30 feet and dim light another 30, or as an action to duplicate Mage Hand. If you fall unconscious within 10 feet, the spirit stabilizes you. Dispel Evil and Good releases it and removes the lantern’s magic.
/wondrous-items:gloomwrought-armor: While worn, gain advantage on saves to avoid or end frightened. It has 3 charges, regains 1d3 at dawn, and can spend one to cast Calm Emotions (DC 15).
/wondrous-items:gulthias-staff: This magic quarterstaff has 10 charges, regaining 1d6 + 4 at dusk. On a hit, spend a charge to regain HP equal to its damage; each expenditure requires a DC 12 Wisdom save against short-term madness. While attuned, blights and evil plant creatures are not hostile unless harmed. Breaking or burning it kills blights that hear its scream within 300 feet.
/wondrous-items:helm-of-the-gods: While worn, detect and locate celestials and fiends within 30 feet unless behind total cover. After a long rest, pray to a listed god to store its spell, replacing the previous spell. The helm has 3 charges, regains 1d3 at dawn, and spends one to cast its stored spell (DC 13).
/wondrous-items:iggwylvs-horn: Use an action to blow it and cast Arms of Hadar, Fog Cloud, Gust of Wind, or Web (save DC 13). Each spell can be cast once per dawn.
/wondrous-items:lash-of-immolation: This whip grants +1 to attack and damage and deals an extra 1d6 fire on a hit. A critical hit restrains the target until your next turn starts. Once per dawn on a hit, use your reaction to increase the extra fire damage to 2d6.
/wondrous-items:loadstone: A 150 gp gem whose curse escapes Detect Magic but is revealed by Identify. Using Dash or Disengage while carrying it activates the curse: speed decreases by 5 feet, maximum load and lift are halved, and you cannot willingly part with it until Remove Curse or similar magic.
/wondrous-items:mimir: Use a bonus action to release or stow this floating 5-pound skull. While floating, use an action to cast Legend Lore once per dawn; it also answers basic planar questions aloud. Others can seize it with an unarmed strike against AC 22 or DC 22 Dexterity (Acrobatics). It has AC 22, 25 HP, poison and psychic immunity, and resistance to other damage.
/wondrous-items:mirror-of-the-past: Use an action while holding it to view accurate but random, cryptic scenes from a chosen creature’s or object’s past for up to one minute. Recharges at dawn.
/wondrous-items:molten-bronze-skin: Attunement molds the bronze onto your skin; it can be worn beneath clothing and cannot be removed without your choice. While worn, gain fire resistance, and the armor imposes no disadvantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks.
/wondrous-items:orb-of-the-stein-rune: While carried, you cannot be petrified. Use an action to gain advantage against forced movement for one minute or until moving; enemies entering within 10 feet must pass DC 12 Strength or stop moving. Cast Meld into Stone as a bonus action once per short or long rest. Eight hours transfers the magic, destroying the orb, to a shield resisting ranged weapon damage or boots granting Strength-save advantage and a reaction to avoid prone.
/wondrous-items:piwafwi-of-fire-resistan: Functions as a Cloak of Elvenkind and grants fire resistance while worn. One continuous hour of sunlight removes its magic.
/wondrous-items:potion-of-invulnerabilit: Gain resistance to all damage for one minute after drinking.
/wondrous-items:professor-orb: This sentient 5-pound scholar has Intelligence 18, sees and hears 60 feet, knows four languages and four narrow academic specialties, and has +9 on relevant lore checks. It casts Mage Hand at will only to move itself. Wisdom and Charisma are each 3d6; alignment varies. Professor Skant has the specific traits and specialties listed in its entry.
/wondrous-items:ring-of-temporal-salvati: If you die while wearing it, reappear in an unoccupied space within 5 feet or the nearest available space with 3d6 + Constitution modifier HP. Raise your maximum HP if needed to match that amount and reduce exhaustion by one level. The ring turns to dust.
/wondrous-items:rogues-mantle: Gain darkvision 60 feet, or extend existing darkvision by 60 feet. From dim light or darkness, teleport as a bonus action up to 30 feet to a visible unoccupied space also in dim light or darkness; gain advantage on your first melee attack before the turn ends. Cast Antagonize (DC 15) once per dawn.
/wondrous-items:saint-markovias-thighbon: Has the properties of a Mace of Disruption. If it hits a vampire or vampire spawn during a battle, it crumbles to dust when that battle ends.
/wondrous-items:scroll-of-protection: An action reading the scroll creates a moving 5-foot-radius, 10-foot-high barrier for five minutes against its specified creature type. That type cannot enter or affect anything inside; moving so one would be inside ends the effect. A creature can overcome it for itself with an action and DC 15 Charisma check.
/wondrous-items:shadowfell-shard: Attach or detach from a Tiny object as an action; it falls off when attunement ends and serves as a focus while held or worn. When using Metamagic, choose one targeted creature and an ability; through your next turn it has disadvantage on checks and saves using that ability.
/wondrous-items:shrieking-greaves: The greaves have 3 charges, regaining 1d3 at dawn. Spend one as a bonus action for +30 feet walking speed and Dexterity-save advantage for one minute. Their curse prevents removal or ending attunement until Remove Curse or similar magic and imposes disadvantage against fear. Starting your turn frightened triggers a scream: you and creatures within 10 feet save Constitution DC 15 against 2d8 thunder, half on success.
/wondrous-items:spider-staff: This magic quarterstaff deals an extra 1d6 poison on a weapon hit. Its 10 charges regain 1d6 + 4 at dusk; cast Spider Climb for one or Web for two (DC 15). Spending the last charge destroys it on a d20 roll of 1.
/wondrous-items:staff-of-the-ivory-claw: While held, gain +1 to spell attack rolls. A critical hit with a spell attack deals an extra 3d6 radiant damage.
/wondrous-items:stonespeaker-crystal: While carried, gain advantage on Intelligence (Investigation). Its 10 charges regain 1d6 + 4 at dawn; cast Speak with Animals (2), Speak with Dead (4), or Speak with Plants (3). Substitute it for a consumed divination material component at one charge per spell level without consuming the crystal. Spending the last charge makes it vanish on a d20 roll of 1.
/wondrous-items:teleportation-tablet: Study its sigil for 10 minutes and succeed on DC 21 Intelligence (Arcana) to learn the destination. Break it as an action on the destination circle’s plane to create a 10-foot teleportation circle in an unoccupied space within 30 feet, connecting to that circle until your next turn ends. The tablet is consumed.
/wondrous-items:ventilating-lungs: Attunement replaces your lungs; they return when it ends. The replacement supports normal breathing even in antimagic, and outside suppression lets you breathe in any environment and gain advantage against harmful gases. Once per dawn use an action to cast Gust of Wind without components (DC 15).
/wondrous-items:wand-of-winter: The wand has 7 charges, regaining 1d6 + 1 at dawn. As an action cast Ray of Frost at +5 to hit (free, or 1 charge at fifth level), Sleet Storm (3), or Ice Storm (4), DC 15, without components. On spending the last charge it melts on a d20 roll of 20.
/wondrous-items:wayfarers-boots: While worn, gain +10 feet walking speed and advantage on Wisdom (Survival). Once per dawn use a bonus action to cast Expeditious Retreat.
/wondrous-items:woodcutter-s-axe: Gain +1 to attack and damage rolls. Hits against plants, Plant creatures, or unattended wooden objects deal an extra 2d6 slashing damage.
/wondrous-items:absorbing-tattoo: The needle becomes a tattoo upon attunement. Gain resistance to its color’s associated damage type. Once per dawn, use a reaction when taking that type to gain immunity to that instance and regain HP equal to half the damage otherwise taken.
/wondrous-items:antimagic-armor: Once per dawn while worn, use a reaction to gain advantage on a saving throw against a spell. Separately, cast Antimagic Field without components once per dawn.
/wondrous-items:armor-of-safeguarding: While wearing it, increase maximum HP by 10 plus your level. Once per dawn use an action to cast Beacon of Hope for one minute without concentration.
/wondrous-items:blade-of-the-medusa: On a natural 20, the target makes a DC 15 Constitution save or becomes restrained and repeats the save each turn; three successes end it, three failures petrify for one hour. Creatures immune to its damage, without flesh, or with legendary actions are immune. Its curse prevents willingly parting with it until removed; on a natural 1 you face the same petrification saves.
/wondrous-items:bloodseeker-ammunition: Ranged attacks using this ammunition have advantage against creatures below their full hit points.
/wondrous-items:bow-of-melodies: Before each ranged attack choose one melody. Precision grants +1 to attack if proficient in Performance, or +2 with expertise. Reverberation adds your Charisma modifier as thunder damage on a hit.
/wondrous-items:cauldron-of-rebirth: A spellcasting focus and Scrying component. After a long rest it creates a greater healing potion that expires after 24 hours. Enlarge or shrink it as an action; covering a humanoid corpse inside with 200 pounds of salt for eight hours consumes the salt and revives it as Raise Dead at dawn. Revival recharges after seven days.
/wondrous-items:clockwork-armor: The armor has 4 charges and regains 1d4 at dawn. While wearing it, spend a charge to replace a d20 roll you make with a 10.
/wondrous-items:crown-of-whirling-comets: The crown has 6 charges and regains 1d6 at dawn. Spend one as a bonus action for ten minutes of flight at walking speed with hover. As an action, spend charges to fire one automatic 2d4 cold bolt per charge at visible creatures within 120 feet, or spend 3 to cast Ice Storm (DC 16).
/wondrous-items:deck-of-wild-cards: As an action, draw randomly and throw a card as a Dexterity-based ranged spell attack within 30 feet; it returns after the attack. A hit deals 1d4 slashing and its suit adds a fire, lightning, cold, or force effect, including saves and conditions detailed in the table (DC 15).
/wondrous-items:dispelling-stone: Throw up to 30 feet to destroy the stone and end active spells of 5th level or lower in a 10-foot-radius sphere at impact.
/wondrous-items:eldritch-staff: This +1 quarterstaff has 10 charges, regaining 1d6 + 4 at dawn. On a melee hit spend up to 3 charges for 1d8 lightning per charge. When damaged while holding it, use a reaction and 3 charges to teleport up to 60 feet to a visible unoccupied space and become invisible until your next turn or until attacking, casting, or dealing damage. Last charge destroys it on a d20 roll of 1.
/wondrous-items:fish-suit: Don or doff in one minute. While worn, breathe in an airless environment and ignore harmful surrounding gases. Gain a swim speed equal to walking speed underwater and a flying speed equal to walking speed in zero gravity.
/wondrous-items:forcebreaker-weapon: Gain +2 to attack and damage rolls. A strike automatically shatters a Large or smaller magical force structure, or a 20-foot cube of a Huge or larger one.
/wondrous-items:helm-of-devil-command: While worn, locate and identify devils within 1,000 feet and communicate or broadcast telepathically. Spend one of 3 charges as an action to cast Dominate Monster on a devil (DC 21); a non-devil target wastes the charge. All charges return 24 hours after the last is spent. A non-devil using this in the Nine Hells risks a 20% chance of attracting a narzugon in 1d4 hours.
/wondrous-items:hunters-coat: While worn, gain +1 AC. The coat has 3 charges, regaining 1d3 at dawn; on hitting a creature below full HP, spend one for an extra 1d10 necrotic damage.
/wondrous-items:kyrzins-ooze: Drink to attune; gain acid and poison resistance and immunity to poisoned. Once per dawn each, become amorphous for one minute to pass through 1-inch spaces, or exhale a 30-by-5-foot acid line (DC 15 Dexterity, 8d8, half on success). The symbiote cannot be voluntarily removed or unattuned; curse-ending magic expels it. On death it transforms your corpse into a hostile-aligned black pudding.
/wondrous-items:living-armor: Wear throughout attunement. Gain +1 AC and resistance to necrotic, poison, and psychic damage. It cannot be removed or voluntarily unattuned; curse-ending magic detaches it. After each long rest, feed it half your remaining Hit Dice rounded up or gain one exhaustion level.
/wondrous-items:mindblasting-cap: Once per dawn as a bonus action, project a 60-foot cone. Creatures make a DC 15 Intelligence save: 5d8 psychic damage and stunned for one minute on failure, half damage on success. A stunned creature repeats the save at each turn’s end.
/wondrous-items:mistral-mantle: Gain cold resistance while worn. When moving within 5 feet of a creature, force DC 14 Dexterity or deal 1d6 cold and knock it prone, at most once per creature per turn. Once per dawn cast Sleet Storm (DC 14) as an action; its terrain and obscurement do not hinder you.
/wondrous-items:nimbus-coronet: While worn, take no falling damage and teleport with carried gear as a bonus action to a visible unoccupied space within 15 feet. Once per dawn use an action to take cloud form for one minute, until incapacitated, or dismissed: fly 60 feet and resist bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage.
/wondrous-items:pennant-of-the-vind-rune: While carried, cannot suffocate and can use an action to fly 20 feet, falling if unsupported afterward. Once per short or long rest each, negate falling damage as a reaction or cast Levitate as a bonus action. Eight hours transfers its power and destroys it: armor gains speed and removes Stealth disadvantage; boots or cloak grant limited flight and Feather Fall.
/wondrous-items:potion-of-longevity: Drinking reduces physical age by 1d6 + 6 years, minimum age 13. Each subsequent such potion adds a cumulative 10% chance of aging by 1d6 + 6 years instead.
/wondrous-items:reincarnation-dust: Sprinkle on a dead humanoid or part of one; a willing creature returns to life in a new body as with Reincarnate.
/wondrous-items:rod-of-hellish-flames: An arcane focus; while held, gain fire and necrotic resistance. Once per dawn each, cast Hellish Rebuke at fourth level (DC 16), or maximize the damage of a fire or necrotic spell instead of rolling.
/wondrous-items:ruidium-shield: While carried, gain psychic resistance, water breathing, and swimming speed equal to walking speed. When taking psychic damage while holding it, use a reaction to deal the damage you would have taken to a visible creature within 30 feet. Each use requires a DC 20 Charisma save or one exhaustion level and ruidium corruption. If the Apotheon is killed or redeemed, it becomes a +2 shield.
/wondrous-items:sapphire-buckler: While wielded, resist psychic and thunder damage. When a creature within 5 feet damages you, use a reaction to deal it 2d6 thunder. Once per dawn, use an action to detect the direction of all aberrations within one mile until your next turn ends.
/wondrous-items:skull-helm: While worn, resist cold, poison, and necrotic damage; cast Spirit of Death without material components once per dawn.
/wondrous-items:spear-of-backbiting: This +2 spear adds 30 feet to both thrown ranges, deals an extra damage die when thrown, and returns after a throw. The curse prevents willingly parting with it and imposes disadvantage using other weapons until removed. On a natural 1 with it, make another attack with advantage against your own AC and take normal spear damage on a hit.
/wondrous-items:steel: A sentient lawful good +2 longsword (Intelligence 8, Wisdom 11, Charisma 15), speaking Common and Draconic and sensing 60 feet. Once per dawn use an action to cast Revivify by touching its target with the sword.
/wondrous-items:sword-of-the-paruns: This +1 weapon grants one held benefit per turn: after attacking with it using Attack, a creature within 60 feet may use its reaction for a weapon attack; after you Dash, one may move its speed; after you Dodge, one may gain Dodge using its reaction.
/wondrous-items:tidecaller-trident: This +2 trident grants advantage on its attacks underwater. Its 3 charges regain 1d3 at dawn; spend one for Control Water or three for Tsunami, both DC 15.
/wondrous-items:watchful-helm: While worn, gain +1 AC, awareness of surroundings while asleep, and advantage on sight-based Wisdom (Perception). Once per dawn cast See Invisibility as a bonus action.
/wondrous-items:wyrmreaver-gauntlets: Your unarmed hits deal an extra 1d6 force. After each long rest choose acid, cold, fire, lightning, or poison resistance. Once per dawn as a bonus action summon spectral fists for one minute or until incapacitated: your unarmed strikes on your turn reach 30 feet, and an unarmed opportunity hit forces a Strength save (DC 8 + proficiency + Strength) against prone.
/wondrous-items:black-crystal-tablet: At the end of the next long rest after attunement, make a DC 20 Wisdom save or suffer random long-term madness. An attuned creature can cast Eyebite or Gate as an action; Gate connects only to the Far Realm. After either spell, recharge at dawn.
/wondrous-items:blood-fury-tattoo: Attune using the needle. The tattoo has 10 charges, restored at dawn. Spend one on a weapon hit for an extra 4d6 necrotic damage and regain HP equal to that damage. When a visible creature damages you, spend one and your reaction to make a melee attack against it with advantage.
/wondrous-items:danoths-visor: Dormant: see in magical and ordinary darkness 60 feet and gain advantage on sight-based Investigation and Perception. Awakened: see invisible and ethereal creatures within 60 feet, gain spyglass magnification, and use one minute of penetration vision once per dawn. Exalted: automatically detect visible illusions and succeed on their saves, see auras around transformed creatures, and cast Antimagic Field once per dawn.
/wondrous-items:deck-of-several-things: Declare the number of random draws in advance, drawing each within one hour of the previous or remaining cards draw themselves together. Drawn effects occur immediately; cards return except Fool and Jester. Effects vary by card and include adventure-specific wealth, allies, spells, curses, imprisonment, and death; consult the linked card descriptions.
/wondrous-items:dragonstaff-of-ahghairon: While held, gain advantage on saves against dragon spells and dragon-type breath weapons. Touch a dragon-type creature to let it bypass Waterdeep’s dragonward until touched again or a stated time. The staff has 10 charges, regaining 1d10 at dawn; spend one as an action to cast Command, giving a dragon disadvantage on its save.
/wondrous-items:euryales-aegis: While wielded, resist poison and cannot be petrified. Once per dawn as a bonus action target a visible creature within 30 feet: DC 20 Constitution or restrained, then another save at its next turn’s start; failure petrifies for 24 hours. Cast Lesser Restoration, Locate Creature, and Transport via Plants once each per dawn.
/wondrous-items:flail-of-tiamat: This +3 flail adds 5d4 acid, cold, fire, lightning, or poison damage on a hit, your choice. Once per dawn while held, use an action and command word to breathe a 90-foot cone: DC 18 Dexterity, 14d6 chosen damage type, half on success.
/wondrous-items:gurts-greataxe: A giant-sized 325-pound +1 greataxe dealing 3d12 slashing, plus 2d12 against humans. It sheds torchlight below 0°F. Once per dawn use an action to cast Heat Metal modified to deal cold damage (DC 13).
/wondrous-items:hazirawn: A sentient neutral evil greatsword: unattuned it is +1 and adds 1d6 necrotic; attuned it is +2 and adds 2d6. While attuned and held, its 4 charges regain 1d4 at midnight; cast Detect Magic or Detect Evil and Good for one, Detect Thoughts for two. A hit prevents healing for one minute, ending early on a DC 15 Constitution save at turn end.
/wondrous-items:heretic: A sentient chaotic evil +3 sword with 6 charges, regaining 1d4 + 1 at dawn. Once per turn on a hit spend one to force DC 17 Constitution or paralyze until your next turn; celestials have disadvantage. While held, cast Detect Evil and Good (1), Fly (2), or True Seeing (3). It has Intelligence 17, Wisdom 17, Charisma 15, senses 120 feet, and communicates telepathically.
/wondrous-items:holy-symbol-of-ravenkind: The symbol has 10 charges, regaining 1d6 + 4 at dawn. Spend one as an action to paralyze vampires and spawn within 30 feet on a failed DC 15 Wisdom save for one minute, repeating saves at turn end. Spend three with Turn Undead or Turn the Unholy to impose save disadvantage. Spend five as an action for 30-foot sunlight and 30 feet dim light for ten minutes.
/wondrous-items:infernal-tack: First equip a subdued nightmare with the tack. Its spur wearer can summon it as an action; it appears within 20 feet at the start of your next turn, acts on your initiative, and remains one day, until dismissed or either dies. A dead nightmare reforms in the Nine Hells after 24 hours. It serves the spur wearer until death or tack removal.
/wondrous-items:jesters-mask: While worn, use it as a focus and gain +3 to Charisma-based spell attacks and save DCs. Once per dawn each, react to an attack hit to take no damage and teleport with gear to a visible unoccupied space within 30 feet, or treat a natural 1 on a d20 as a 20.
/wondrous-items:longbow-of-the-healing-h: This +3 longbow creates magic arrows if unloaded. Its 8 charges regain 1d4 + 1 at dawn. Once per turn replace an attack with a one-charge curative arrow that automatically reaches a visible creature within 150 feet, letting it spend a Hit Die and heal that roll plus your Wisdom modifier (minimum +1). Cast Create Food and Water (1), Warding Bond (2), or Guardian of Faith (3), DC 18.
/wondrous-items:matalotok: While holding this hammer, gain cold immunity. Whenever it damages a creature, every creature in a 30-foot-radius sphere takes 3d6 cold damage.
/wondrous-items:nepenthe: A sentient neutral evil +3 sword dealing an extra 2d10 radiant to fiends and undead. While drawn, you and allies within 10 feet have advantage on saves against spells and magical effects; the radius becomes 30 feet at paladin level 17. It has Intelligence 10, Wisdom 8, Charisma 18 and telepathically communicates with its wielder.
/wondrous-items:nightfall-pearl: Spend ten minutes to turn the area within ten miles to night for 24 hours, until canceled as an action, or until attunement ends. Recharges after 24 hours.
/wondrous-items:orcsplitter: A sentient lawful good +2 axe. On a natural 20 against an orc, it must succeed on DC 17 Constitution or drop to 0 HP. While held and not incapacitated, you cannot be surprised by orcs, sense uncovered orcs within 120 feet without location, and you and friends within 30 feet cannot be frightened.
/wondrous-items:potion-of-giant-size: If Medium or smaller, become Huge for 24 hours, Strength becomes 25 unless higher, current and maximum HP double, and melee reach increases 5 feet. Equipment enlarges; enlarged weapons roll triple their normal damage dice. HP above your normal maximum become temporary when the effect ends.
/wondrous-items:rakdos-riteknife: A +1 dagger traps souls of creatures it kills, up to five; each adds 1d4 necrotic on its hits, and trapped creatures require Wish to revive. Release souls as a bonus action to regain 1d10 HP each. With five souls, release them as a reaction after a hit: a target below 75 HP must pass DC 15 Constitution or die. If it dies, this property recharges after a long rest.
/wondrous-items:rod-of-resurrection: The rod has 5 charges and regains one at dawn. While held, cast Heal for one charge or Resurrection for five as an action. At zero charges, it vanishes on a d20 roll of 1.
/wondrous-items:scroll-of-tarrasque-summ: Read as an action to summon a tarrasque in a visible unoccupied space within one mile. It is hostile to all other creatures and disappears at 0 HP.
/wondrous-items:shield-of-the-blazing-dr: Activate as a bonus action once per dawn for one minute. Gain fire immunity; use an action to end one disease or blinded, charmed, deafened, or poisoned condition on a visible creature within 30 feet. Once per turn replace an attack with a bash: Strength save DC 8 + proficiency + Strength, 3d6 bludgeoning plus 3d6 fire and prone on failure, half damage on success.
/wondrous-items:spell-bottle: Stores one spell of up to fifth level. Cast a 1st–5th-level spell into an empty bottle, or react to a visible spell cast within 60 feet: automatically capture level 3 or lower; for higher levels make Intelligence check DC 10 + spell level. While holding it, cast the stored spell using the original caster’s slot level, DC, attack bonus, and ability; it then empties.
/wondrous-items:stormgirdle: Dormant: Strength 21 unless higher, lightning and thunder resistance, and once per dawn become a Storm Avatar for one minute with those immunities, converted weapon damage, and a bonus-action 3d6 lightning strike (DC 15 Dexterity, half). Awakened raises Strength to 23, strike to 4d6, and grants 30-foot flight with hover in avatar form. Exalted raises Strength to 25, strike to 5d6, and grants Control Weather once per dawn.
/wondrous-items:sword-of-the-planes: A +3 sword. Once per dawn use an action to cut a rift in an unoccupied space within 5 feet to another plane, up to 10 feet high and wide, lasting one minute. Anything entering is transported to the selected plane near the specified destination at the DM’s discretion.
/wondrous-items:telescopic-transporter: Calibrate for one hour and make DC 17 Intelligence (Arcana). Success teleports you and eight willing creatures touching it, with gear, to the observed celestial body; failure produces a mishap from the table, possibly involving a different destination, hostile encounter, or destructive explosion.
/wondrous-items:topaz-annihilator: A two-handed ranged weapon, range 100/300, dealing 2d6 necrotic. Targets reduced to 0 HP by this damage become dust; creatures require True Resurrection or Wish to return. While carried, cast Disintegrate (DC 18) once per dawn.
/wondrous-items:waythe: A sentient neutral good +1 greatsword. Hits on giants deal an extra 2d6 slashing and require DC 15 Strength or prone. It also works as a Wand of Enemy Detection, regaining all charges at dawn without destruction risk. Good creatures attune in one minute.
/wondrous-items:witchlight-vane: An attuned wielder uses it as a +3 mace adding 1d8 radiant, cannot be blinded, deafened, petrified, or stunned, and can cast Dancing Lights, Polymorph, or Ray of Frost using Charisma without components. After Polymorph, a d8 roll of 3 or 8 blocks reuse until dawn. The holder is vulnerable to lightning. It senses carnival mood and can locate its happiest creature.
/wondrous-items:ythryn-mythallar: Up to eight creatures attune during a short rest within 30 feet; all attuned creatures must agree to its use. From the same plane, direct it to fly at 30 feet with matter within 500 feet. Within 30 feet, recharge an item as an action, subject to its own subsequent recharge, or cast Control Weather with a 50-mile radius. Touching the globe requires DC 22 Constitution against 20d10 + 70 radiant, half on success; objects are disintegrated except artifacts and its cradle.
/wondrous-items:axe-of-the-dwarvish-lord: A +3 axe with Belt of Dwarvenkind, Dwarven Thrower, and Sword of Sharpness properties and random artifact properties. Attuned dwarves gain poison immunity, +60 feet darkvision, and three crafting proficiencies. Once per dawn summon an earth elemental; once per three days teleport via fixed dwarven stonework, with reliable underground arrival. Nondwarves gradually acquire a dwarflike appearance under a persistent removable curse.
/wondrous-items:blade-of-avernus: Functions as a Vorpal Sword and has random artifact properties. As an action charm a visible devil within 60 feet for one hour on a failed DC 22 Charisma save; suicidal orders end the effect and prevent reuse on that devil. Cast Word of Recall as an action to reach the ruler of Avernus or your designated sanctuary if you rule.
/wondrous-items:book-of-vile-darkness: After 80 hours of study, raise one ability by 2 (maximum 24), lower another by 2 (minimum 3), and gain a dark mark with social advantages. Non-evil attunement risks becoming neutral evil on DC 17 Charisma; the book abandons those who neglect evil and may imprison an attuned bearer’s soul on death. It grants random properties, DC 18 Dominate Monster against evil once per dawn, doubled proficiency on evil lore, and damaging Dark Speech.
/wondrous-items:crown-of-lies: Attune by wearing it and speaking a true desire. As an action assume the exact appearance, voice, size, and speed of a creature seen before within one size category, retaining other statistics. The disguise lasts until death, attunement ends, or changed; lies appear truthful and only Wish reveals your nature. It also has random beneficial and detrimental properties.
/wondrous-items:demonomicon-of-iggwilv: The tome has 8 charges, regaining 1d8 at dawn, and casts listed fiend-related spells (DC 20), plus Tasha’s Hideous Laughter. It doubles proficiency on demon lore and Abyss survival, maximizes spell damage against fiends, and strengthens Magic Circle and Planar Binding against them. Once per dawn trap a circled fiend on a failed DC 20 Charisma save with disadvantage. A trapped fiend may attempt possession after a long rest, DC 20.
/wondrous-items:grovelthrash: A sentient evil warhammer: dormant +1, optional extra 2d6 bludgeoning at cost of 1d6 psychic, double damage to objects, and lie-detection advantage. Awakened +2 grants burrowing and once-daily reflected attack damage. Exalted +3 grants rock burrowing, extra 2d6 below half HP, and Earthquake, Meld into Stone, and Stone Shape each once per dawn (DC 17).
/wondrous-items:khrusor: A +3 spear adding 2d8 radiant, shedding sunlight 30 feet and dim light 30 more. Heliod worshipers gain benefits at piety thresholds; nonworshipers suffer two major detrimental properties. Once per dawn, react to nearby damage with a spear attack that blinds on a hit. Its 10 charges regain 1d6 + 4 at dawn; cast Guiding Bolt (1), Daylight (3), or Sunbeam (6), DC 18.
/wondrous-items:mace-of-the-black-crown: A sentient lawful evil mace. Dormant +1, ignites as a bonus action for 1d6 fire and summons a friendly imp for ten minutes once per dawn. Awakened +2 adds 2d6 fire, poison resistance, and a bearded devil option. Exalted +3 adds 3d6 fire that ignores fire resistance, fire resistance for the wielder, and a barbed devil option.
/wondrous-items:orrery-of-the-wanderer: Within 30 feet, gain +1 AC; attunement gradually changes alignment to chaotic neutral and compels dangerous planar exploration. Six components can be attuned separately or installed without additional attunement slots. With all installed, its 7 charges regain 1d4 + 4 at dawn and cast Contact Other Plane (3), Demiplane (6), Gate (7), Plane Shift (5), or Teleportation Circle (3), DC 17. It also has random artifact properties.
/wondrous-items:ruins-wake: A sentient chaotic evil spear: dormant +1, adds 1d8 piercing, returns after ranged attacks, and grants a reactive attack once per rest. Awakened +2 and 2d8, with a once-per-dawn 120-foot lightning line (DC 15 Dexterity, 8d6, half). Exalted +3 grants a once-per-dawn battle cry giving chosen allies attack advantage and healing equal to damage on a killing hit once per dawn.
/wondrous-items:staff-of-the-forgotten-o: A +3 quarterstaff adding 3d6 necrotic; while carried, double proficiency on Arcana and History, gain immunity to six listed conditions, and avoid hostility from low-CR undead. Its 7 charges regain 1d4 + 3 at dawn; spend one as an action to curse a visible creature within 60 feet on a failed Constitution save against your spell DC, preventing healing and giving necrotic vulnerability. Each use by anyone but Acererak risks possession (DC 20 Charisma).
/wondrous-items:sword-of-zariel: The sentient sword chooses its wielder and immediately attunes, permanently transforming them to lawful good with Charisma at least 20, radiant and necrotic resistance, 90-foot flying with hover, and 60-foot truesight. Hits add 2d8 radiant, or 3d10 two-handed; evil targets save DC 17 Constitution or are blinded until their next turn ends. Its light hinders fiend attacks, and the holder gains Insight advantage.
/wondrous-items:the-infernal-machine-of-: This 5,500-pound artifact grants spells and random beneficial and detrimental effects; its remote silver wire can extend virtually indefinitely, but severing it kills its user. Spell DC is 14 or your higher spell DC. Conjuration spells recharge daily, weekly, or monthly; Wish recharges monthly with a cumulative 10% malfunction chance requiring seven days and 500 gp to repair. Each long rest generates 1d4 + 1 beneficial and detrimental properties from its table.
/wondrous-items:wyrmskull-throne: A seated bearer attuned to and holding a Ruling Scepter controls this hovering throne; others sitting on it are paralyzed and enclosed in force. Its 9 charges return at dawn. It flies 30 feet and passes through earth or stone freely; spend 1 for ninth-level Lightning Bolt (DC 19, 14d6), 2 for Globe of Invulnerability, or 3 for a spectral ancient blue dragon attacking each turn for one minute.
/wondrous-items:mask-of-the-dragon-queen: Formed by combining at least two Dragon Masks. While attuned and worn, choose properties from any one mask, gain each of the five masks’ Damage Absorption properties, and gain five uses of Legendary Resistance.
/wondrous-items:radiance: While holding this mirror-shaped wand, gain +1 to spell attacks and ignore half cover for them. It sheds dim light 5 feet in darkness. An attuned holder can cast Enhance Ability on themselves as a bonus action once per dawn.
/wondrous-items:tearulai: A sentient neutral good Sword of Sharpness: maximize weapon damage dice against objects; a natural 20 against a creature adds 14 slashing and a second natural 20 severs a limb. Evil creatures cannot attune and take 20 psychic damage for trying. Its 6 charges regain 1d4 + 2 at dawn; cast Fly (2), Polymorph (3), or Transport via Plants (4) without materials. Its magic is suppressed until removed from Valdemar’s skull.
/wondrous-items:armor-of-gleaming: This medium or heavy armor stays clean.
/wondrous-items:bead-of-refreshment: Dissolves in liquid to turn up to 1 pint into fresh, cold drinking water. It cannot affect magical liquids or harmful substances such as poison.
/wondrous-items:breathing-bubble: Wear over your head to breathe from its one-hour air supply. The supply fully replenishes at dawn.
/wondrous-items:charlatans-die: When you roll this attuned six-sided die, you choose the result.
/wondrous-items:cloak-of-billowing: While wearing the cloak, use a bonus action to make it billow dramatically.
/wondrous-items:clothes-of-mending: The traveler’s outfit repairs ordinary wear automatically, but cannot restore destroyed pieces.
/wondrous-items:dark-shard-amulet: Warlock attunement required. While worn, it serves as a warlock spellcasting focus. Once per long rest, attempt an unknown warlock cantrip with a DC 10 Intelligence (Arcana) check; failure wastes the casting action.
/wondrous-items:earring-of-message: The worn earring has 5 charges. Use an action and 1 charge to cast Message; it regains 1d4 + 1 charges at dawn.
/wondrous-items:everbright-lantern: This bullseye lantern sheds a 120-foot cone: bright light for the first 60 feet and dim light for the remaining 60 feet.
/wondrous-items:hat-of-wizardry: Wizard attunement required. While worn, the hat is a wizard spellcasting focus. Once per long rest, attempt an unknown wizard cantrip with a DC 10 Intelligence (Arcana) check; failure wastes the casting action.
/wondrous-items:illuminators-tattoo: Attune by pressing its needle to your skin; the tattoo disappears and the needle returns when attunement ends. Your fingertip writes like an inexhaustible ink pen. Once per dawn, use an action to conceal up to one page of writing for 24 hours from everyone except you and a named creature; either can end the effect by touch.
/wondrous-items:instrument-of-scribing: Has 3 charges, all restored at dawn. While playing, use an action and 1 charge to write up to six words in a known language on a nonmagical surface within 30 feet. A bard adds seven words and can make the writing glow faintly. It lasts 24 hours or until dispelled.
/wondrous-items:lock-of-trickery: Attempts to pick this lock have disadvantage on Dexterity checks. It comes with one key.
/wondrous-items:medal-of-muscle: Use an action to squeeze the medal for advantage on Strength checks and saves for 1 hour. It then becomes nonmagical.
/wondrous-items:medal-of-the-maze: Use an action to trace the medal for advantage on Wisdom checks and knowledge of the quickest route through any nonmagical path or maze for 1 hour. It then becomes nonmagical.
/wondrous-items:medal-of-wit: Use an action to press the medal to your temple for advantage on Intelligence checks and saves for 1 hour. It then becomes nonmagical.
/wondrous-items:moon-touched-sword: In darkness, the unsheathed sword sheds bright moonlight for 15 feet and dim light for another 15 feet.
/wondrous-items:orb-of-gonging: Use an action to align the bronze rings. The orb sounds a gong every 6 seconds, audible up to 600 feet away, until the rings are misaligned.
/wondrous-items:perfume-of-bewitching: One use. Apply with an action for advantage on Charisma checks directed at humanoids of challenge rating 1 or lower for 1 hour; affected creatures do not notice magical influence.
/wondrous-items:pole-of-angling: Speak a command word while holding the 10-foot pole to turn it into a fishing pole with line, hook, and reel. Repeat the word to restore its original form.
/wondrous-items:potion-of-watchful-rest: For 8 hours after drinking, magic cannot put you to sleep and you can stay awake during a long rest while gaining its benefits. It has no effect on creatures that do not need sleep.
/wondrous-items:rope-of-mending: This 50-foot rope can be cut and, as an action with a command word, rejoined when the pieces touch and are not in use. Lost or destroyed sections permanently shorten it.
/wondrous-items:sekolahian-worshipping-s: Once per hour, the shark statuette deals 1 piercing damage to a Tiny sea-dwelling animal within 1 inch of its mouth.
/wondrous-items:smoldering-armor: While worn, the armor emits harmless, odorless wisps of smoke.
/wondrous-items:staff-of-adornment: While holding the staff, float up to three objects of at most 1 pound each an inch above its tip. They remain until removed or the staff leaves your possession; you can make them slowly spin.
/wondrous-items:strixhaven-pennant: While waved, the pennant glitters and sheds bright light for 10 feet and dim light for another 10 feet.
/wondrous-items:tankard-of-sobriety: Nonmagical alcohol drunk from the tankard does not intoxicate you. It does not affect magical liquids or harmful substances.
/wondrous-items:veterans-cane: While grasping the cane, speak its command word as a bonus action to transform it permanently into a nonmagical longsword.
/wondrous-items:wand-of-conducting: Has 3 charges, restored at dawn. As an action, expend 1 and wave the wand to create orchestral music audible within 60 feet until you stop waving. Expending the last charge destroys it on a d20 roll of 1, accompanied by a sad tuba sound.
/wondrous-items:wand-of-smiles: Has 3 charges, restored at dawn. As an action, spend 1 to target a visible humanoid within 30 feet; a failed DC 10 Charisma save forces a smile for 1 minute. On a d20 roll of 1 after the last charge, it becomes a Wand of Scowls.
/wondrous-items:alchemy-jug-blue: Use an action to select a liquid, then an action to uncork and pour up to 2 gallons per minute. It produces no acid or poison but can produce up to 1 quart of boiling tea. One liquid and its daily maximum are available until the next dawn; see its table for quantities.
/wondrous-items:amulet-of-the-devout: Cleric or paladin attunement required. While worn, the amulet grants +1, +2, or +3 to spell attacks and spell save DCs according to rarity. Once per dawn, use Channel Divinity without expending a use.
/wondrous-items:armor-of-fungal-spores: While wearing the medium armor, use a bonus action once per dawn to release spores in a 10-foot-radius sphere. Creatures there must make a DC 15 Constitution save or be poisoned until the end of your next turn.
/wondrous-items:bag-of-bounty: A creature with the Mark of Hospitality can use an action to cast Create Food and Water from the bag up to three times per day, resetting at dawn. Finer meals require a Charisma check, adding cook’s utensils proficiency if applicable; failure creates poor food. DCs are 10, 13, 15, and 18 for modest through aristocratic fare.
/wondrous-items:barrier-tattoo: Attune using its needle; the tattoo vanishes and the needle returns when attunement ends. Without armor, it sets AC to 12 + Dexterity modifier (uncommon), 15 + Dexterity modifier capped at +2 (rare), or 18 (very rare). A shield remains compatible.
/wondrous-items:blood-spear: When a melee hit with this attuned spear reduces a target to 0 hit points, gain 2d6 temporary hit points.
/wondrous-items:boomerang-shield: This attuned shield can be thrown as a ranged weapon at 20/60 feet using Strength or Dexterity. Shield proficiency grants attack proficiency; it deals 1d6 slashing damage and immediately returns to your hand after hitting or missing. It also grants the usual +2 AC while wielded.
/wondrous-items:cap-of-water-breathing: While underwater and wearing the cap, use an action and its command word to create breathable air around your head. The bubble lasts until the word is repeated, the cap is removed, or you leave the water.
/wondrous-items:coiling-grasp-tattoo: Attune using its needle; the tattoo vanishes and the needle returns when attunement ends. As an action, target a visible creature within 15 feet: a failed DC 14 Strength save deals 3d6 force damage and grapples it. Escape requires an action and DC 14 Athletics or Acrobatics; the grapple also ends if dismissed, the target moves beyond 15 feet, or another creature is targeted.
/wondrous-items:deck-of-miscellany: The box holds 32 illustrated cards. As an action, choose a card and throw it into an unoccupied space within 5 feet; it permanently becomes its depicted item or items. See the item’s table for the available objects.
/wondrous-items:dragonhide-belt: Monk attunement required. While worn, the belt adds +1, +2, or +3 to ki feature save DCs by rarity. Once per dawn, use an action to regain ki points equal to one Martial Arts die roll.
/wondrous-items:dried-leech: When this ammunition hits with a ranged attack, the animated leech attaches and deals 1d4 piercing damage at the start of each target turn. It falls off after dealing at least 10 damage or when the target dies. Any creature can detach it as an action; once detached it dies and loses its magic.
/wondrous-items:dust-of-deliciousness: Contains enough dust for six servings. Treated food tastes better, but anyone eating it has disadvantage on Wisdom checks and saves for 1 hour.
/wondrous-items:emerald-pen: The pen needs no ink. While holding it, cast Illusory Script at will without material components.
/wondrous-items:finders-goggles: Attunement by a creature with the Mark of Finding required. While worn, add 1d4 to Insight checks. Once per dawn, use an action to examine an object and make an Insight check against DC 13 plus days since last touched; success reveals the last creature’s type and lets you immediately cast Locate Creature for it.
/wondrous-items:guardian-emblem: Cleric or paladin attunement required. Attach to or remove from armor or a shield as an action. While wearing or wielding it, use your reaction and 1 of its 3 charges when you or a visible creature within 30 feet suffers a critical hit to make it a normal hit. All charges return at dawn.
/wondrous-items:harkon-s-bite: While worn, gain +1 to ability checks and saves. Attunement curses you so the necklace cannot be removed until Harkon Lukas removes it or Remove Curse or similar magic ends the curse. Putting it on or taking it off causes werewolf lycanthropy until the dawn after the next full moon; continued wear renews it.
/wondrous-items:house-of-cards: Once per dawn, shuffle as an action to create a card shelter in a 40-foot cube centered within 30 feet. Only you operate its door and up to four windows; it maintains a comfortable temperature. It has AC 15, 50 hit points, poison and psychic immunity, and lasts 24 hours, until dismissed as an action, or destroyed.
/wondrous-items:insignia-of-claws: While wearing it, your unarmed strikes and natural weapons gain +1 to attack and damage rolls and count as magical.
/wondrous-items:lorehold-primer: Spellcaster attunement required. Three charges, regaining 1d3 at dawn; spend one after rolling an Intelligence (History or Religion) check while holding it to add 1d4. Study after a long rest to choose a 1st-level cleric or wizard spell; cast it once without a slot while holding the primer before your next long rest, using Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma.
/wondrous-items:mind-carapace-armor: Only its designated mind flayer or thrall can attune. That wearer gains advantage on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saves and immunity to fear. For anyone else it is ordinary heavy armor.
/wondrous-items:mummy-rot-antidote: Drinking the potion cures mummy rot.
/wondrous-items:paper-bird: Write up to 50 words and name a recipient on your plane; the sheet becomes a Tiny bird flying 60 feet per round by the most direct route. Within 5 feet of the recipient it becomes parchment only they can unfold. It has AC 13 and 1 hit point and becomes ash if immobilized, reduced to 0 hit points or speed, or sent to another plane.
/wondrous-items:plate-of-knights-fellows: While wearing the attuned plate, summon an allied knight spirit with a bonus action in an unoccupied space within 30 feet once per dawn. It follows your commands, acts immediately after you, and otherwise Dodges and avoids danger. It lasts 1 minute or until reduced to 0 hit points.
/wondrous-items:potion-of-fire-breath: For up to 1 hour after drinking, use a bonus action to breathe fire at a target within 30 feet up to three times. A DC 13 Dexterity save halves 4d6 fire damage. The effect ends after the third breath.
/wondrous-items:prehistoric-figurines-of: As an action, throw the figurine within 60 feet and speak its command word to summon its friendly creature if space permits. It obeys spoken commands and reverts at 0 hit points, on expiry, or when touched and dismissed as an action. Plesiosaurus lasts 12 hours/recharges in 4 days and grants Water Breathing while ridden; pteranodon 8 hours/7 days; triceratops 6 hours/10 days; tyrannosaurus 1 hour/14 days. Each command to the tyrannosaurus risks loss of control on a d20 roll of 1.
/wondrous-items:psi-crystal: Attunement requires Intelligence 3 or higher. Grants telepathy and light while attuned; Intelligence 3–7 gives 15-foot telepathy, 8–11 gives 30 feet, 12–15 gives 60 feet, and 16+ gives 120 feet. Light increases with Intelligence as listed in the item table.
/wondrous-items:rhythm-makers-drum: Bard attunement required. While held, grants +1, +2, or +3 by rarity to bard spell attacks and save DCs. Once per dawn, play it as an action to regain one Bardic Inspiration use.
/wondrous-items:ring-of-the-orator: Has 6 charges, regaining 1d6 at dawn. Spend 1 while worn to project your voice clearly within 1 mile for 1 minute, overcoming noise but blocked by magical silence or specified barriers. You can make visible listeners understand a language they otherwise do not know.
/wondrous-items:robe-of-serpents: The attuned robe has 1d4 + 3 serpents. As a bonus action, detach one as a giant poisonous snake that acts on your initiative and attacks hostile creatures. It vanishes after 1 hour, at 0 hit points, or when dismissed. Detached snakes do not return; the robe loses its magic when all are gone.
/wondrous-items:saddle-of-the-cavalier: While conscious in this saddle, you cannot be dismounted against your will, and attacks against your mount have disadvantage.
/wondrous-items:sending-stones: The paired stones cast Sending between their bearers as an action while touching one stone, once per pair per dawn. If the other stone has no bearer, you learn that without casting. Destroying one makes the other nonmagical.
/wondrous-items:serpent-scale-armor: This scale mail allows your full Dexterity modifier to AC and does not impose disadvantage on Stealth checks.
/wondrous-items:shield-of-the-tortoise: Wielding the shield grants +1 AC beyond its normal shield bonus. Its attunement curse prevents discarding it or ending attunement until Remove Curse or similar magic; your speed is halved and your initiative d20 is always treated as 1 and cannot be changed.
/wondrous-items:sling-of-giant-felling: When a ranged hit from this sling strikes a Giant, it must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution save or fall prone.
/wondrous-items:spell-gem: Holds one spell up to its gemstone-specific maximum. While holding it, cast a known or class-list spell as an action without components; if it exceeds your casting level, a spellcasting ability check against DC 10 + spell level is required, and failure expends it. Attunement lets you store a qualifying spell in an empty gem once per dawn. The gem determines maximum level, spell DC, and attack bonus; see its table.
/wondrous-items:luckstone: While this attuned stone is on your person, gain +1 to ability checks and saving throws.
/wondrous-items:sword-of-vengeance: Grants +1 to attack and damage. Its curse makes you keep it on your person and imposes disadvantage on attacks with other weapons. When damaged in combat while carrying it, a DC 15 Wisdom save prevents you from compulsively attacking the damaging creature until either of you falls to 0 hit points or you cannot reach it. Banishment expels the spirit, leaving an ordinary +1 sword.
/wondrous-items:wand-of-the-war-mage: Spellcaster attunement required. While held, the wand grants +1, +2, or +3 to spell attack rolls by rarity and lets spell attacks ignore half cover.
/wondrous-items:wildspace-orrery: Within a Wildspace system, it projects and automatically tracks the system’s suns, planets, moons, and comets, marking its own position with a pulsing white light.
/wondrous-items:witherbloom-primer: Spellcaster attunement required. Three charges, regaining 1d3 at dawn; spend one after rolling a Nature or Survival check while holding it to add 1d4. Study after a long rest to choose a 1st-level druid or wizard spell; cast it once without a slot while holding the primer before your next long rest, using Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma.
/wondrous-items:alchemical-compendium: Wizard attunement required. This spellbook and focus contains six listed transmutation spells. It has 3 charges, regaining 1d3 at dawn. Spend 1 charge and 1 minute studying to replace a prepared wizard spell with a transmutation spell in the book; as an action, spend charges to transform an unattended nonmagical object into one of equal or lesser value. Maximum size is 1 foot per side for 1 charge, plus 2 feet per additional charge.
/wondrous-items:astromancy-archive: Wizard attunement required. This spellbook and focus contains the listed divination spells; a bonus action folds or unfolds it. Three charges regain 1d3 at dawn. Spend 1 and a minute studying to replace a prepared wizard spell with a divination spell in the archive, or use a reaction and 1 charge after a visible creature within 30 feet rolls an attack, check, or save to add or subtract 1d4 before the outcome.
/wondrous-items:banner-of-the-krig-rune: While unfurled, you see invisible creatures within 20 feet in line of sight. As a bonus action, grant allies within 20 feet fear immunity for 10 minutes, or impose disadvantage on ranged attacks against them for 1 minute; each power recharges on a short or long rest and ends when furled. An 8-hour ritual destroys the banner to grant chosen creatures fear immunity and +1 attack and AC within a fixed 500-foot-radius sphere.
/wondrous-items:blod-stone: While carrying the attuned diamond, use an action to sense the direction and distance of the nearest non-undead creature whose blood is inside it or who is related to that creature.
/wondrous-items:bracer-of-flying-daggers: As an action, draw up to two magical daggers and immediately throw each with a ranged attack. They vanish if not thrown immediately and after hitting or missing. The bracer supplies daggers without limit.
/wondrous-items:bridle-of-capturing: While holding the bridle, speak its command word as an action to target a visible beast within 20 feet. On a failed DC 17 Charisma save, it is bridled and controlled as by Dominate Beast; on success it is immune until dawn. You can release it as a bonus action; it can make a DC 17 Charisma check at each dawn to escape.
/wondrous-items:charm-of-plant-command: Has 3 charges, all restored at dawn. While carrying it, use an action and 1 charge to cast Speak with Plants; during the spell you have advantage on Charisma checks to influence plants.
/wondrous-items:claws-of-the-umber-hulk: While wearing both attuned claws, gain a 20-foot burrowing speed and tunnel through solid rock at 1 foot per round. Each is a proficient melee weapon dealing 1d8 slashing using Strength. You cannot manipulate objects or cast spells with somatic components while wearing them.
/wondrous-items:crystal-blade: On a hit, the sword deals an extra 1d8 radiant damage. It has 3 charges, regaining 1d3 at dawn; spend one on a hit to heal hit points equal to that extra damage. While holding it, use a bonus action to select bright light for 30 feet plus dim for 30, dim light for 10 feet, or darkness.
/wondrous-items:delvers-claws: This light, finesse simple melee weapon deals 1d4 slashing. While attuned, gain burrowing speed equal to walking speed and blindsight 15 feet. Once per dawn, invoke its rune as an action and roll up to your proficiency bonus in unspent Hit Dice, regaining their total plus your Constitution modifier in hit points.
/wondrous-items:docent: Warforged attunement requires embedding this sentient sphere. It communicates telepathically, perceives through your senses, translates its languages, and controls its own powers. At the end of your turn at 0 hit points it can make a +6 Medicine check to stabilize you. It has a +7 skill and casts Detect Magic or Detect Evil and Good at will, determined randomly.
/wondrous-items:dragon-wing-bow: This attuned bow deals an extra 1d6 damage of its dragon breath type on a hit. If drawn without ammunition it creates a magic arrow that vanishes immediately after hitting or missing.
/wondrous-items:eagle-whistle: While continuously blowing it, fly at twice your walking speed for up to 5 + five times your Constitution modifier rounds (minimum 1). Talking, holding breath, suffocating, or landing ends the use; stopping in the air causes a fall. Three uses return at dawn.
/wondrous-items:far-realm-shard: Sorcerer attunement required. Attach to or detach from a Tiny object as an action; it serves as a focus while held or worn. When you use Metamagic, a visible creature within 30 feet must save against your spell DC or take 3d6 psychic damage and be frightened of you until your next turn starts.
/wondrous-items:feywrought-armor: While wearing the attuned armor, gain advantage on saves to avoid or end being charmed. It has 3 charges, regaining 1d3 at dawn; use an action and 1 charge to cast Compulsion (DC 15).
/wondrous-items:fulminating-treatise: Wizard attunement required. The listed evocation spells are in this spellbook and focus. Its 3 charges regain 1d3 at dawn. Spend 1 and a minute studying to swap a prepared wizard spell for an evocation spell in the book; or use a reaction and 1 charge when a visible creature takes damage from your evocation spell to deal 2d6 extra force damage and knock it prone if Large or smaller.
/wondrous-items:gauntlets-of-flaming-fur: While wearing both attuned gauntlets, nonmagical weapons held in either count as magical. Once per dawn, use a bonus action to ignite one or two held melee weapons; each deals 1d6 extra fire damage until either weapon is sheathed or released.
/wondrous-items:glamoured-studded-leathe: While wearing this studded leather, gain +1 AC. Use a bonus action and command word to make it look like normal clothing or other armor, retaining its true bulk and weight. The illusion lasts until changed again or the armor is removed.
/wondrous-items:glowrune-pigment: Contains 1d4 + 2 pots, each sufficient for one rune painted in 10 minutes. A creature can benefit from one rune for 8 hours or until wiping it off as an action.
