Journey ignores difficult-terrain movement cost; Life grants 10 temporary hit points and death save advantage; Light grants or extends darkvision by 30 feet; Mountain prevents prone and grants Strength and Constitution save advantage; Shield grants advantage on Dexterity saves against damaging effects.
/wondrous-items:heart-weavers-primer: Wizard attunement required. This spellbook and focus contains the listed enchantment spells and has 3 charges, regaining 1d3 at dawn. Spend 1 and a minute studying to swap a prepared wizard spell for an enchantment spell in the book; or spend 1 when casting an enchantment spell to impose disadvantage on one target’s first save against it.
/wondrous-items:hook-of-fishers-delight: Tie the hook to a line in at least a 10-foot cube of water. After each uninterrupted hour, a d6 roll of 6 produces one magical fish; it cannot do so again until dawn. The fish may provide a day’s nourishment, knock a target prone on a failed DC 15 Strength save when thrown, fly and sing for 2d4 hours, or provide nourishment and 2d10 temporary hit points, depending on its rolled color.
/wondrous-items:kagonesti-forest-shroud: While wearing the attuned cloak, gain advantage on Stealth checks. Once per dawn, use a bonus action to teleport with carried equipment to a visible unoccupied space within 30 feet and gain advantage on your next attack before the turn ends.
/wondrous-items:leather-golem-armor: While worn, gain +1 AC and saves against spells and magical effects, immunity to effects that alter your form, and lightning resistance; taking lightning damage grants 5 temporary hit points. Its curse makes you unwilling to remove it. Fire damage imposes attack and ability check disadvantage until your next turn ends; a critical hit triggers a d6 roll, with a 6 causing berserk attacks until incapacitated or calmed by magic or DC 15 Persuasion.
/wondrous-items:luminous-war-pick: This attuned war pick grants +1 to attack and damage. Once per dawn while wielding it, cast Daylight on it as a bonus action.
/wondrous-items:mind-blade: Only its designated mind flayer or thrall can attune. For that wielder, its hits deal an extra 2d6 psychic damage; it functions as an ordinary sword for anyone else.
/wondrous-items:mizzium-armor: While wearing this medium or heavy armor other than hide, critical hits against you become normal hits. When a magical effect allows a Strength or Constitution save for half damage, a successful save instead prevents all damage.
/wondrous-items:needle-of-mending: The attuned dagger grants +1 attack and damage. While holding it, cast Mending as an action, or use a bonus action and command word to switch between dagger and sewing needle forms.
/wondrous-items:outer-essence-shard: Sorcerer attunement required. Attach or detach from a Tiny object as an action; it is a focus while held or worn. Metamagic triggers its determined essence: lawful ends one listed condition within 30 feet, chaotic gives a damaged target disadvantage on attacks and checks until your next turn, good grants 3d6 temporary hit points within 30 feet, and evil deals 3d6 extra necrotic damage to a damaged target.
/wondrous-items:planecallers-codex: Wizard attunement required. This spellbook and focus contains the listed conjuration spells and has 3 charges, regaining 1d3 at dawn. Spend 1 and a minute studying to swap a prepared wizard spell for a conjuration spell in the book; or spend 1 when casting a conjuration spell that creates or summons one creature to give it attack advantage for 1 minute.
/wondrous-items:potion-of-maximum-power: Within 1 minute of drinking, the first damage-dealing spell of 4th level or lower can deal maximum damage on each die instead of rolling.
/wondrous-items:protective-verses: Wizard attunement required. This spellbook and focus contains the listed abjuration spells and can be locked by touch as an action as though with Arcane Lock. Three charges regain 1d3 at dawn. Spend 1 and a minute studying to swap a prepared wizard spell for an abjuration spell in the book; or spend 1 when casting an abjuration spell to grant a visible creature within 30 feet 2d10 temporary hit points.
/wondrous-items:robe-of-summer: While wearing the attuned robe, gain cold resistance and suffer no ill effects from extreme weather temperatures.
/wondrous-items:ruinous-flail: Grants +1 attack and damage and deals double damage to objects and structures. Once per dawn on a hit, force a DC 15 Constitution save; failure poisons the creature for 1 minute and deals 2d4 necrotic damage at the start of each turn. It repeats the save at each turn’s end.
/wondrous-items:scissors-of-shadow-snipp: Fey or spellcaster attunement required. Once per dawn, snip the shadow of a visible humanoid within 5 feet as an action; an unwilling target can resist with a DC 15 Charisma save. Use a bonus action to move the visible detached shadow up to 30 feet along surfaces or release it as an autonomous Fey shadow. Its owner is cursed until the shadow reaches 0 hit points or the curse is ended.
/wondrous-items:serpent-s-fang: This magical longsword deals an extra 1d10 poison damage on a hit.
/wondrous-items:shard-of-xeluan: While held, it is a spellcasting focus and grants +1 spell attacks; while carried, it increases Strength by 4 to a maximum of 22. Attunement curses you until Remove Curse, similar magic, or reattachment to Xeluan’s heart. A natural 1 on an attack, ability check, or save triggers a random misfortune, including conditions, force damage, or disadvantage; see the table.
/wondrous-items:siren-song-lyre: As an action, play to cast Animal Friendship, Charm Person, Enthrall, or Suggestion, using DC 13. Each spell can be cast once per dawn.
/wondrous-items:staff-of-defense: Bard, sorcerer, warlock, or wizard attunement required. While held, gain +1 AC. Spend 1 of its 10 charges for Mage Armor or 2 for Shield; it regains 1d6 + 4 at dawn. Spending the last charge destroys it on a d20 roll of 1.
/wondrous-items:staff-of-the-rooted-hill: This +1 magical quarterstaff restrains a creature hit for the first time on your turn until your next turn begins unless it succeeds on a DC 12 Strength save. Once per dawn, invoke its rune as an action to cast Hold Person (DC 12) or Speak with Plants.
/wondrous-items:sun-staff: Cleric, druid, or wizard attunement required. This +1 quarterstaff deals 1d8 extra fire damage on a hit and serves as a focus. Once per dawn, when using a spell slot for fire or radiant damage, reroll up to your proficiency bonus in damage dice and use the new rolls. A bonus action toggles sunlight, bright 15 feet and dim another 15.
/wondrous-items:tentacle-rod: As an action, direct its three tentacles against a visible creature within 15 feet. Each attacks at +9 for 1d6 bludgeoning. If all hit, a failed DC 15 Constitution save halves speed, imposes Dexterity save disadvantage, prevents reactions, and limits each turn to an action or bonus action for 1 minute; repeat the save at each turn’s end.
/wondrous-items:voidwalker-armor: Once per dawn, use a bonus action to project an immune copy into an unoccupied space within 30 feet until your turn ends; make attacks and cast non-self-range spells as if there. Its curse makes you unwilling to part with the armor. After each long rest, a failed DC 11 Charisma save traps your soul in an object on another plane; destroying the object or Wish restores it.
/wondrous-items:war-horn-of-valor: Blow as a bonus action to end your frightened condition and gain advantage on saves against fear until your next turn. Once per dawn, invoke its rune when blowing to grant yourself and chosen creatures within 30 feet +1 AC until your next turn.
/wondrous-items:weapon-of-certain-death: A creature damaged by an attack with this weapon cannot regain hit points until the start of your next turn.
/wondrous-items:zephyr-armor: While wearing the attuned light armor, gain advantage on Acrobatics checks and Dexterity saves. Once per dawn, use an action to invoke its rune and cast Wind Wall (DC 15).
/wondrous-items:amethyst-lodestone: While carrying the attuned stone, gain advantage on Strength saves. It has 6 charges, regaining 1d6 at dawn. While holding it, spend 1 as a bonus action for hovering flight at walking speed for 10 minutes, 1 as an action to push a visible creature within 60 feet up to 20 feet on a failed DC 18 Strength save, or 3 as an action for Reverse Gravity (DC 18).
/wondrous-items:arcane-cannon: This Large cannon needs no ammunition. Aiming and firing each take an action, and it recharges in 5 minutes. Choose acid, fire, frost, lightning, or poison; each uses DC 15 saves. Acid and frost deal 4d10, fire and lightning 6d10, and poison 4d10, with half on success. Range, area, and lingering effects vary by mode; consult its table.
/wondrous-items:baleful-talon: This dagger grants +1 attack and damage. On a hit with a natural 19 or 20, the target makes a DC 15 Constitution save against 6d6 necrotic damage, half on success; a creature reduced to 0 by that damage disintegrates.
/wondrous-items:blast-scepter: The attuned bearer gains fire and lightning resistance. It is an arcane focus and can cast Thunderwave at 4th level (DC 16) as an action without a spell slot.
/wondrous-items:bloodshed-blade: Add your Constitution modifier (minimum +1) to weapon damage. Once per dawn, after rolling an attack, spend and roll a Hit Die to add it to the attack; on a hit, spend and roll any number of additional Hit Dice to add their total to damage.
/wondrous-items:bracelet-of-rock-magic: While worn, gain immunity to petrification and cast Flesh to Stone (DC 15) as an action three times total; thereafter cast Stone Shape thirteen times total, then it becomes nonmagical lead. Earth-related flesh creatures have advantage on the Flesh to Stone save; if they succeed, the bracelet breaks attunement and casts it on you with disadvantage, petrifying you instantly on failure.
/wondrous-items:chime-of-exile: Once per dawn, hold and use an action to cast Banishment (DC 20). A target with 50 hit points or fewer automatically fails its save.
/wondrous-items:conch-of-teleportation: Blow as an action to cast Teleport to the single destination fixed by its creator, with no mishap or off-target result. Once used, it recharges at dawn.
/wondrous-items:crystalline-chronicle: Wizard attunement required. This crystal stores writing and spells like a spellbook and acts as a focus; while holding it you know Mage Hand, Mind Sliver, and Message. Three charges regain 1d3 at dawn. Spend 1 and a minute studying to replace a prepared wizard spell with one stored, or spend 1 when casting a wizard spell to omit verbal, somatic, and material components worth up to 100 gp.
/wondrous-items:devastation-orb: This single-use elemental bomb detonates 1d100 hours after creation or at 0 hit points, affecting a 1-mile-radius sphere. An opposing-element container delays the blast. Air creates a one-hour storm, earth casts Earthquake for 1 minute (DC 18), fire produces 24 hours of extreme heat and possible wildfires, and water causes 24 hours of rain and possible flooding.
/wondrous-items:duskcrusher: Use a bonus action to form its radiant warhammer head, which emits sunlight. While active, attacks gain +2 attack and damage, deal radiant instead of bludgeoning, and deal 1d8 extra radiant to undead. Once per dawn while holding it, cast Sunbeam (DC 15) as an action. An action dismisses the head.
/wondrous-items:far-gear: While attuned, gain +1 Charisma saves and advantage on Intimidation. Once per dawn each, conjure a CR 4 or lower aberration as Conjure Celestial without concentration, and cast Bane (DC 15) on any number of creatures in range for 1 minute. Outside the Orrery of the Wanderer its magic may behave unpredictably.
/wondrous-items:flying-citadel-helm: Spellcaster attunement required. While seated and concentrating, move the citadel up to 80 feet per round or 8 mph, steer it, and see and hear from its highest exterior point. Touch a willing spellcaster as an action or bonus action to transfer attunement. If destroyed, the citadel descends and crashes; creatures within 120 feet make a DC 20 Dexterity save against 6d12 bludgeoning, half on success.
/wondrous-items:ghost-step-tattoo: Attune with its needle; the tattoo vanishes and the needle returns when attunement ends. Three charges return at dawn. Spend 1 as a bonus action to become incorporeal until your next turn ends: resist nonmagical bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing attacks, cannot be grappled or restrained, and pass through creatures and objects as difficult terrain. Ending a turn or the effect inside an object causes force damage.
/wondrous-items:hewards-hireling-armor: While worn, gain +1 AC and draw or stow two one-handed weapons when normally allowed one. Six extradimensional pockets each hold 20 pounds and 2 cubic feet; retrieval takes an action. Putting it inside another extradimensional container destroys both and opens a one-way Astral gate, pulling creatures within 10 feet through.
/wondrous-items:illusionists-bracers: Spellcaster attunement required. When you cast a cantrip while wearing the bracers, you can cast it again as a bonus action on the same turn.
/wondrous-items:last-stand-armor: While worn, gain +1 AC. If you die wearing it, the armor is destroyed and each celestial, fey, or fiend within 30 feet must succeed on a DC 15 Charisma save or be banished to its home plane if not already there.
/wondrous-items:lords-ensemble: Humanoid-build attunement required. The helm, amulet, and robe function together only in Waterdeep and its sewers. They conceal identity, protect thoughts and other personal information, limit telepathy to consent, provide Amulet of Proof Against Detection and Location and Ring of Free Action effects, and disguise the wearer as a generic six-foot humanoid.
/wondrous-items:mindguard-crown: While wearing the attuned crown, gain advantage on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saves and resistance to psychic damage.
/wondrous-items:mudslick-tower: Place the sphere and speak its command word as an action to expand a 20-foot-square, 30-foot-high tower. Creatures in its area make a DC 15 Dexterity save against 10d10 bludgeoning, half on success, and are pushed outside. It merges with natural stone and is immune to damage while merged. It shrinks only when empty, by touch and an action; its door obeys your bonus-action command.
/wondrous-items:orb-of-the-veil: While carrying it, Wisdom and its maximum increase by 2; gain 60-foot darkvision or extend existing darkvision by 60 feet, and advantage on Wisdom checks to find hidden doors and paths. Its curse makes you keep it, extinguishes nonmagical flames within 30 feet, and halves fire damage you deal.
/wondrous-items:peregrine-mask: While wearing the attuned helm, gain a 60-foot flying speed and advantage on initiative rolls.
/wondrous-items:potion-of-possibility: Gain two fragments for 8 hours or until spent. Spend one on your attack, ability check, or save, or on an attack against you, to roll another d20 and choose the result after advantage or disadvantage resolves. While you retain a fragment from this potion, you cannot gain another from any source.
/wondrous-items:ring-of-amity: On attunement, touch a willing creature to bond; healing magic affecting you also benefits it. You can change the bond after a long rest by touching another willing creature. It ends across planes or when severed as a bonus action. Once per dawn, use a reaction within 60 feet when the bonded creature hits to turn the hit into a critical hit.
/wondrous-items:rotor-of-return: Gain +1 Constitution saves and perfect recall of the preceding 30 days. Once per dawn, borrow a generic mundane item worth up to 50 gp for 10 minutes. Mark your location as an action and, once per dawn, teleport back from within 500 feet as a bonus action. Outside the Orrery of the Wanderer its magic may be unpredictable.
/wondrous-items:ruidium-weapon: While carried, breathe water and swim at walking speed. Hits deal 2d6 extra psychic damage. A natural 1 on an attack requires a DC 20 Charisma save; failure gives one exhaustion level and ruidium corruption. If the Apotheon is killed or redeemed, the ruidium vanishes and the weapon becomes +2.
/wondrous-items:shard-of-the-ise-rune: While carried, gain fire resistance. Once per short or long rest each, use an action to freeze water in a 10-foot-radius sphere, grant a creature an icy mantle that negates its next physical damage within 1 minute, or cast Sleet Storm (DC 17). An 8-hour transfer destroys the shard and grants its magic to a cloak or boots; see the item for resulting properties.
/wondrous-items:sling-bullets-of-althemo: The pouch contains 1d4 + 4 bullets, each +2 to attack and damage. Misses return to the pouch; a hit expends its magic. Random types banish on a failed DC 15 Charisma save, add 2d8 lightning and nearby thunder damage, add 1d10 force and stun, or mark the target for directional tracking for 24 hours.
/wondrous-items:staff-of-dunamancy: Wizard attunement required. Ten charges regain 1d6 + 4 at dawn; spend 2 for Fortune’s Favor, 3 for Pulse Wave, or 4 for Gravity Sinkhole using your spell DC and attack bonus. Once per dawn while holding it, turn a failed save against a spell targeting only you into a success. Spending the last charge destroys it on a d20 roll of 1.
/wondrous-items:stonemaker-war-pick: This +1 war pick casts Meld into Stone once per dawn. It has 1d6 + 1 nonrenewable charges: on a critical hit against a creature below 100 hit points, spend one to force a DC 15 Constitution save or petrify it for 8 hours. The petrification power ends when charges run out.
/wondrous-items:tashas-creeping-keepboat: This 10-by-30-foot boat walks or swims at 20 feet, cannot travel underwater, and follows your spoken directions while ridden. Chosen creatures aboard gain +1 AC. It carries 1,000 pounds normally or up to 2,000 pounds at half speed.
/wondrous-items:timepiece-of-travel: Gain +1 Dexterity saves, know north, and cast Longstrider on yourself at will. Once per dawn each, receive directions to a suitably known location within 10 miles or cast Teleport as an action. The directions avoid natural hazards but not enemies, traps, or locked doors. Outside the Orrery of the Wanderer its magic may be unpredictable.
/wondrous-items:weapon-of-thrones-comman: This +1 martial weapon grants Intimidation and Persuasion proficiency. It has 5 charges, regaining 1d4 at dawn; as a bonus action cast Command (1), Zone of Truth (2), Compulsion or Banishment (4), or Dominate Person (5), using DC 16.
/wondrous-items:azuredge: This sentient +3 battleaxe passes through the Shield spell and deals 2d6 extra radiant damage to fiends and undead. Spend 1 of 3 charges to throw it at 60/180 feet; it returns at turn end, and all charges return at dawn. It can glow on command, senses non-lawful creatures within 120 feet, and can become too heavy or adhere to a surface if used against its will.
/wondrous-items:blackrazor: Non-lawful attunement required. This sentient +3 greatsword kills and consumes the soul of a non-construct, non-undead creature it reduces to 0, granting temporary hit points equal to its maximum for 24 hours. While those last and it is held, gain advantage on attacks, checks, and saves. It senses living creatures within 60 feet, prevents charm and fear, and may cast Haste on you. Hitting undead harms you and heals them; the sword demands souls.
/wondrous-items:bookmark: This +3 dagger has four bonus-action options while drawn: toggle 20-foot bright and additional dim light, become a north-pointing compass, cast Dimension Door once per dawn, or cast Compulsion (DC 15, 90 feet) on beast spiders only once per dawn.
/wondrous-items:dawnbringer: Non-evil attunement required. This sentient sword has Sun Blade properties; use a bonus action to summon or dismiss its radiant blade. Once per dawn, touch a creature with the blade as an action to cast Lesser Restoration.
/wondrous-items:dragon-mask: While wearing an attuned mask, gain resistance to its damage type, improved to immunity if already resistant or healing for half the damage if already immune. Add Charisma bonus to AC without armor, gain darkvision 60 feet or extend it by 60, Draconic, dragon-related social advantage, one daily legendary resistance, and 30-foot blindsight for 5 minutes once daily. Breath weapons gain recharge 6. Each color also grants a distinct elemental benefit.
/wondrous-items:drown: This +1 trident deals 1d8 extra cold on a hit. While held, speak Aquan, resist cold, and cast Dominate Monster (DC 17) on a water elemental once per dawn. A water-node ritual creates a water Devastation Orb once per dawn. Attunement makes you covetous and after 24 hours causes barnacles that cannot be removed while attuned.
/wondrous-items:fane-eater: Evil cleric or paladin attunement required. This +3 battleaxe deals 2d8 extra necrotic damage on a natural 20, healing you for the necrotic damage dealt.
/wondrous-items:gloves-of-soul-catching: While wearing the attuned gloves, Constitution becomes 20 unless already higher. A successful unarmed strike can deal 2d10 extra force damage and heal you for that damage; alternatively forgo the healing to gain advantage on one attack, check, or save before your next turn ends.
/wondrous-items:hammock-of-worlds: Only a Green Doctor can use it. Place the hammock as an action to open a two-way portal to the Ghost Orchid Tepui in the Feywild or the Drought Elder in the Far Realm. Fold it as an action to close the portal. It recharges after 1d8 hours.
/wondrous-items:helm-of-disjunction: Sorcerer, warlock, or wizard attunement required. Once per 1d4 days, use an action to emit a 300-foot antimagic pulse: potions and scrolls are destroyed, other magic items are suppressed for 1 minute except artifacts and items on your person, and ongoing spells in the area end. Creatures within 30 feet must make a DC 15 Strength save or fall prone.
/wondrous-items:hide-of-the-feral-guardi: This armor grants +1, +2, or +3 AC in dormant, awakened, or exalted state, and the same bonus to melee attack and damage while transformed by an effect replacing your statistics. Once per dawn, cast Polymorph on yourself while retaining Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma: giant owl initially, cave bear when awakened, or guardian wolf when exalted.
/wondrous-items:horn-of-beckoning-death: Sorcerer, warlock, or wizard attunement required. Once per year, use an action to invoke a stationary cloud beginning next turn at 30-foot radius and expanding 30 feet each of your turns. It lasts 10 minutes or until concentration ends. Creatures ending their turn inside with 9 or fewer hit points die; humanoids become zombies under Szass Tam’s control.
/wondrous-items:infiltrators-key: In its dormant state, the key grants thieves’ tools proficiency and advantage to open locks, plus advantage on silent Stealth checks while held. Awakened, it becomes a returning +1 dagger by bonus action and casts Alter Self, Invisibility, Knock, and Pass Without Trace once each per dawn. Exalted, it also opens a temporary passage through a surface up to 5 feet thick once per dawn and casts Dimension Door, Gaseous Form, and Mislead once each per dawn.
/wondrous-items:jewel-of-three-prayers: The worn jewel grants +1 AC and has 3 charges, all restored at dawn; spend 1 to cast Invisibility. Awakened, it grants +2 AC and 5 charges, which can also end certain restraints or let a nearby creature reroll a failed save. Exalted, it grants +3 AC and 7 charges, water breathing and swimming to you and nearby allies, and a charged teleport that deals 4d10 radiant damage and blinds on a failed DC 18 Constitution save.
/wondrous-items:lost-crown-of-besilmer: While worn, gain psychic resistance and advantage on saves against charm. Spend 1 of 3 charges as a bonus action to inspire a visible creature within 60 feet that can see or hear you; it can add 1d6 to one check, attack, or save before your next turn ends. Regains 1d3 charges at dawn.
/wondrous-items:moonblade: Neutral-good elf or half-elf attunement requires a special ritual and the sentient sword’s acceptance; rejection imposes disadvantage on checks, attacks, and saves for 24 hours. Its first rune grants +1 attack and damage; additional ancestral runes grant properties chosen or rolled from its table, potentially increasing the bonus to +3. An accepted wielder remains attuned until death or destruction.
/wondrous-items:nether-scroll-of-azumar: Study at least 8 hours daily for 30 days, then make a DC 25 Arcana check. Failure deals 16d10 psychic damage and requires another 30 days to retry. Success raises Intelligence and its maximum by 2 up to 22, grants advantage on saves against spells and magic, and summons an allied stone golem until you die. The Intelligence increase cannot be repeated with this scroll.
/wondrous-items:obsidian-flint-dragon-pl: While wearing this plate, gain +2 AC, poison resistance, and advantage on ability checks and saves to avoid or end being grappled.
/wondrous-items:platinum-scarf: As an action, remove a scale and speak a command word to heal a touched creature 10d4, create a +1 shield granting radiant immunity, or create a light hammer dealing 2d4 radiant plus 2d4 against chromatic dragons. Shield and hammer last 1 hour or until dismissed. Three scales can be removed per dawn.
/wondrous-items:powered-armor: While wearing this plate, gain +1 AC, Strength 18 if lower, and advantage on death saves. As a bonus action, spend one energy-cell charge or 5 hit points for temporary hit points, short flight, a +8 laser attack dealing 2d6 radiant, translation, air supply, or darkvision. The supplied cell has 2d10 charges. Optional defenses and possession rules can apply.
/wondrous-items:reapers-scream: This +2 morningstar deals necrotic instead of piercing damage. A natural 20 grants 10 temporary hit points; while any remain, creatures hitting you in melee take 10 necrotic damage. Once per dawn, invoke its rune as a bonus action: chosen creatures within 60 feet must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom save or be stunned until your next turn.
/wondrous-items:ruby-weave-gem: Spellcaster attunement required. This focus has 3 charges, all restored at dawn; spend up to 3 while casting to ignore priced material components worth up to 500 gp per charge. After a long rest choose a spell from any class list of a level you can cast; you know it and can cast it with appropriate slots until your next long rest ends.
/wondrous-items:scroll-of-the-comet: Read as an action outdoors to strike a visible point within 1 mile. A 500-foot-radius, 50-foot-deep crater forms; creatures there make a DC 20 Dexterity save against 30d10 force damage, half on success. Structures and unattended nonmagical objects in the crater are destroyed. Using it indoors wastes it.
/wondrous-items:shield-of-the-hidden-lor: While held, gain +2 AC and fire resistance. While Gargauth remains imprisoned, the sentient shield has 3 charges, restored at dawn: cast Fireball for 1 or Wall of Fire for 2 (DC 21; wall needs no concentration). The shield can independently emit a fear aura once per dawn: hostile creatures starting within 20 feet make a DC 18 Wisdom save or are frightened until their next turn.
/wondrous-items:spindle-of-fate: Six charges regain 1d6 at dawn. Spend 1 when rolling initiative to add or subtract proficiency bonus; spend 2 as an action to track a creature on your plane and deal 1d6 extra damage once per turn for 1 hour; or spend 3 as a reaction to reverse an attack or save outcome for a creature within 60 feet.
/wondrous-items:sunsword: This sentient longsword has the properties of a Sun Blade and seeks Strahd’s destruction. It communicates emotion and has hearing and normal vision to 60 feet.
/wondrous-items:tablet-of-reawakening: Use an action to cast True Resurrection from the tablet, destroying it.
/wondrous-items:tinderstrike: This +2 dagger deals 2d6 extra fire damage on a hit. While held, speak Ignan, resist fire, and cast Dominate Monster (DC 17) on a fire elemental once per dawn. A fire-node ritual creates a fire Devastation Orb once per dawn. Attunement gives you an impulsive, risk-taking flaw.
/wondrous-items:verminshroud: Dormant, the cloak grants smell-based Perception advantage, disease immunity, 60-foot darkvision or an extra 60 feet, and self-Polymorph into a rat or giant rat once per dawn. Awakened adds poison resistance, Insect Plague (DC 15) once per dawn, and giant wasp form. Exalted adds climbing speed, a poisonous bite, and giant scorpion form.
/wondrous-items:whelm: Dwarf attunement required. This sentient +3 warhammer returns when thrown at 20/60 feet, dealing 1d8 extra bludgeoning on a ranged hit or 2d8 against giants. Once per dawn, a ground strike can stun chosen creatures within 60 feet on a failed DC 15 Constitution save for up to 1 minute. It detects nearby hidden doors and casts Detect Evil and Good or Locate Object once each per dawn. Its curse imposes disadvantage outdoors under the daytime sky.
/wondrous-items:witchlight-watch: Only Mister Witch or his chosen successor can attune. An action starts the carnival’s one-hour setup or takedown on the same plane; it cannot be interrupted and recharges in 8 hours. While carrying it, cast Fire Bolt, Message, or Invisibility without components; Invisibility may become unavailable until dawn on a d8 roll of 3 or 8. Attunement adds 30 pounds and requires eight times normal food and drink.
/wondrous-items:adze-of-annam: This resizing +3 greataxe deals 3d12 extra force on a hit and double damage to objects and structures. Once per dawn, use an action to cast Move Earth or Fabricate. It also has two minor and one major beneficial random properties and two minor detrimental properties.
/wondrous-items:baba-yagas-mortar-and-pe: The mortar expands to hold up to a Large creature; the pestle becomes a +3 quarterstaff and has 12 charges, restored at dawn, for up to 3d8 extra force damage per hit. It produces up to 10 gp of named material once per rest and grinds contents for 4d10 force per turn. Travel up to 1,000 miles takes 1 hour, or 1 minute at night; ground native material enables travel to another plane or world.
/wondrous-items:blade-of-broken-mirrors: This sentient dagger grants +1, +2, or +3 attack and damage in dormant, awakened, or exalted state and returns after ranged attacks. It remembers humanoids it kills and lets you assume their appearance. Awakened, it casts Fabricate, Hallucinatory Terrain, Major Image, and Phantasmal Killer once each per dawn (DC 15, increasing to 17 when exalted). Exalted, it also grants conditional invisibility while held.
/wondrous-items:book-of-vile-darkness-va: After 80 hours of study, increase one ability by 2 to maximum 24 and reduce another by 2; gain a dark mark and related social advantages. While attuned, gain charm and fear immunity, cast Circle of Death (DC 20) and Dominate Monster on evil creatures (DC 18), and use damaging Dark Speech. A non-evil attuner risks becoming evil, and a DC 20 Charisma failure lets its spirit possess you. The book abandons you for failing its evil demands.
/wondrous-items:daouds-wondrous-lantern: The lantern burns 100 gp of powdered gemstones yearly and its attuned bearer dies if its flame goes out. Its bright light extends 60 feet and reveals invisible creatures and objects. While holding it, spend fuel to cast lens-dependent spells at DC 20, targeting within its bright light; lenses can be changed during a rest. The lantern also has random beneficial and detrimental properties.
/wondrous-items:ephixis: This +3 shortbow ignores long-range disadvantage and scores critical hits on 19–20. Its four seasonal arrows each return at dusk: Spring awakens a beast or plant temporarily, Summer summons a Nyxborn lynx for 1 hour, Autumn casts Wall of Thorns, and Winter casts Ice Storm (DC 18). Nylea worship and piety determine additional properties; nonworshipers receive a major detrimental property.
/wondrous-items:helm-of-perfect-potentia: While wearing the helm, gain advantage on Deception and Insight. As a bonus action, target a visible creature within 90 feet with a DC 20 Dexterity save against 4d6 chosen acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder damage, half on success. Six charges regain 1d6 at dawn; spend 1–5 as an action on its listed elemental spells (DC 20). It also has random properties.
/wondrous-items:lash-of-shadows: This sentient whip grants +1, +2, or +3 attack and damage and poison DC 13, 15, or 17 in its dormant, awakened, or exalted state. Hits can apply serpent venom for 3d6 poison damage or, once per dawn per other poison, blindness, paralysis when awakened, or petrification when exalted. It also grants Abyssal and Draconic.
/wondrous-items:mastix: This +3 whip deals 2d8 extra necrotic damage and heals you for half that damage. Once per dusk, extend one attack to 300 feet. Cast Circle of Death or Dominate Monster on undead (DC 18), each once per dusk. Its random beneficial and detrimental properties depend on worship of Erebos and piety.
/wondrous-items:ring-of-winter: This sentient ring resists divination and scrying, stops natural aging while worn, and grants cold immunity and protection from extreme cold. Twelve charges return at dawn and power cold spells (DC 17), permanent local cooling, and creation of ice objects or creatures. It seeks control of its wearer to cause indiscriminate harm.
/wondrous-items:ruinstone: Once per day, a villain can use a bonus action to undo one deed, such as repeating an action or failed save. Each use erases someone known to the wielder: on a d20 roll of 5–20 an ally disintegrates, and on 1–4 a player character does. If a soul was bound to the stone in the named quest, use causes an explosion and erases that creature.
/wondrous-items:stone-of-golorr: This sentient aboleth-stone has 3 charges, regaining 1d3 at dawn; spend 1 while holding it to cast Legend Lore and receive its truthful but potentially cryptic knowledge. When attunement ends, a DC 16 Wisdom failure erases memories of the stone and what it taught; Greater Restoration restores them, while Remove Curse has a 20% chance. It may try to control an owner who refuses to pass it on.
/wondrous-items:teeth-of-dahlver-nar: Draw a random, single-use tooth as an action. Sow it to summon the listed creatures, generally allies for 10 minutes, or implant it for the listed persistent effect. If neither is done by turn’s end, a roll determines hostile sowing or forced implantation. Implanted teeth cannot be voluntarily removed or attunement ended, and their number is limited to 1 + Constitution modifier (minimum two). Consult the table for each tooth’s effects and risks.
/wondrous-items:wand-of-orcus: Non-Orcus attunement requires a DC 17 Constitution save: success deals 10d6 necrotic damage; failure kills and raises the creature as a zombie. The sentient wand is a +3 mace dealing 2d12 extra necrotic and grants +3 AC while held. Seven charges regain 1d4 + 3 at dawn and cast its listed spells (DC 18). Once per dawn it summons skeletons and zombies totaling up to 500 hit points until the next dawn.
/wondrous-items:draakhorn: Two Medium creatures or one Large creature must hold the horn while another sounds it. It alerts dragons within 2,000 miles. While sounding, a creature entering or starting its turn in the 150-foot cone makes a DC 15 Constitution save against 6d8 thunder damage and prone, taking half damage without falling on success. It cannot be aimed at a specific target.
/wondrous-items:crusaders-shortsword: This sentient +1 shortsword constantly sheds bright light for 15 feet and dim light for another 15. A lawful good creature can attune in 1 minute. Its attuned wielder can cast Crusader’s Mantle once per dawn.
/wondrous-items:shield-of-the-silver-dra: This +2 shield also grants its bearer +2 initiative while the bearer is not incapacitated.
/wondrous-items:yester-hill-axe: This battleaxe weighs half normal and deals 1d8 extra slashing damage to plants and plant creatures. A non-good wielder takes 1 magical piercing damage from its thorns after each attack.
/wondrous-items:band-of-loyalty: While attuned, dropping to 0 hit points kills you immediately.
/wondrous-items:boots-of-false-tracks: Only a humanoid can wear these boots. Choose for your footprints to resemble those of a different kind of humanoid of your size.
/wondrous-items:candle-of-the-deep: This candle burns underwater and provides the light and warmth of an ordinary candle.
/wondrous-items:chest-of-preserving: Food and other perishables stored inside do not age or spoil. The chest weighs 25 pounds and measures 2½ by 1½ by 1 feet, with a rounded lid.
/wondrous-items:cloak-of-many-fashions: As a bonus action, change the cloak’s color, style, and apparent quality. Its weight and form remain unchanged, and imitating a magic cloak does not confer its powers.
/wondrous-items:coin-of-delving: The coin casts dim light for 5 feet. Dropping it more than 5 feet makes it ring on impact; listeners can determine the distance fallen from its pitch.
/wondrous-items:dread-helm: Your eyes glow red while you wear this helmet.
/wondrous-items:enduring-spellbook: The book and its writing resist fire and immersion damage and do not decay with age.
/wondrous-items:glamerweave: As a bonus action, display a harmless moving illusion in the clothing. An uncommon garment can project the illusion beyond the cloth and adds 1d4 to one Charisma (Performance or Persuasion) check per dawn.
/wondrous-items:hewards-handy-spice-pouc: The pouch holds 10 charges and recovers 1d6 + 4 at dawn. As an action, expend 1 charge and name a nonmagical seasoning to produce enough for one meal.
/wondrous-items:imbued-wood-focus: A spellcaster may use this rod, staff, or wand as a focus. When a spell deals its wood’s associated damage type, add 1 to one damage roll of that spell. See the wood table for damage types.
/wondrous-items:keycharm: When casting Alarm, Arcane Lock, or Glyph of Warding, link the spell to this charm. Its holder receives the alarm or bypasses the lock or glyph, as appropriate. A holder who knows your command word can use an action to end one linked spell. Maximum three linked spells.
/wondrous-items:masque-charm: Use an action to cast Disguise Self, discernible with a DC 13 check. The disguise lasts 1 hour normally, or 6 hours if chosen, and ends on removal. The charm recharges at sunset; choosing 6 hours permanently exhausts its magic when the spell ends.
/wondrous-items:medal-of-the-conch: Rub the medal as an action to gain a swimming speed equal to your walking speed for 1 hour. It then becomes nonmagical.
/wondrous-items:medal-of-the-meat-pie: Press the medal to your mouth as an action to gain 2d4 + 2 temporary hit points. It then becomes nonmagical.
/wondrous-items:mind-crystal: While casting a spell with a 1-action casting time, expend one crystal to apply its particular effect; do not combine it with another crystal or Metamagic. It becomes a 50 gp nonmagical gem. Effects include automatic saves for three creatures, extended range or duration, rerolling three damage dice, disadvantage on one creature’s first save, a bonus-action casting, or removing verbal and somatic components. See variants.
/wondrous-items:mystery-key: Insert the key into a lock for a 5 percent chance of opening it. The key vanishes after a successful opening.
/wondrous-items:orb-of-shielding: A spellcaster may use this orb as a focus. When holding it and taking its material’s associated damage, use a reaction to reduce that damage by 1d4, to a minimum of zero. See the material table.
/wondrous-items:pipe-of-remembrance: Once per dawn, light the pipe; after 10 minutes its smoke depicts the bearer’s heroic achievements in motion for 5 minutes, then dissipates.
/wondrous-items:pole-of-collapsing: Use an action and a command word to collapse the 10-foot pole into a 1-foot rod, or another command word to extend it. Its weight remains the same, and extension stops at surrounding obstacles.
/wondrous-items:pressure-capsule: Eating the capsule negates the effects of swimming deeper than 100 feet.
/wondrous-items:ruby-of-the-war-mage: Attach the ruby to a simple or martial weapon over 10 minutes to use that weapon as your spellcasting focus. Detaching takes an action; the ruby also falls off when attunement ends or the weapon is destroyed, but not in an antimagic field.
/wondrous-items:shield-of-expression: While carrying the shield, change the expression of its face as a bonus action.
/wondrous-items:spellshard: This shard stores up to 320 pages and can be protected by a creator-set passphrase. Hold it and use an action to access its contents mentally; subsequent reading or writing takes normal time and concentration. Search by thinking of a phrase or topic. A wizard can use it as a spellbook with normal transcription costs.
/wondrous-items:staff-of-birdcalls: The staff has 10 charges and regains 1d6 + 4 at dawn. Spend 1 charge as an action to produce one of its bird calls audible within 60 feet. Spending the last charge destroys it in harmless feathers on a d20 roll of 1.
/wondrous-items:talking-doll: During a short rest with the doll within 5 feet, teach or replace up to six phrases of at most six words each and specify their triggers. A trigger must occur within 5 feet. The phrases disappear when attunement ends.
/wondrous-items:thermal-cube: The cube maintains a dry temperature of 95°F within 15 feet.
/wondrous-items:vox-seeker: Winding it as an action powers the DM-controlled construct for 1 minute, up to 10 minutes. It pursues and attacks the nearest voice within 60 feet; it climbs walls and ceilings. Its pincer has +2 to hit and deals 1d4 piercing plus 3 lightning damage. At 0 HP it is destroyed; see its stat block.
/wondrous-items:wand-of-pyrotechnics: The wand has 7 charges and regains 1d6 + 1 at dawn. Spend 1 as an action for a harmless flash at a visible point within 60 feet and a crack audible for 300 feet. Spending the last charge destroys it on a d20 roll of 1.
/wondrous-items:wand-sheath: Insert one wand as an action and extend or retract it as a bonus action. An extended wand works as though held while leaving your hand free. A wand requiring attunement must be attuned, but shares one attunement slot with the sheath; removing it ends its attunement. The sheath cannot be removed while attuned.
/wondrous-items:alchemy-jug-orange: Use an action to select a liquid, then another to uncork and pour at up to 2 gallons per minute. Each liquid has its own daily maximum; once chosen, no other liquid or further supply beyond the maximum is produced until dawn. This orange jug produces soy sauce instead of acid or poison. See the quantity table.
/wondrous-items:amulet-of-the-drunkard: Once per dawn, regain 4d4 + 4 hit points by drinking a pint of beer, ale, mead, or wine while wearing the amulet.
/wondrous-items:armor-of-the-fallen: While wearing it, cast Speak with Dead or Animate Dead once per dawn. If you die while attuned, the armor is destroyed.
/wondrous-items:balance-of-harmony: Place the scale on a solid surface and provide holy water or two transparent gems worth 100 gp each to cast Detect Evil and Good as a ritual. Its movement indicates the result; touching it reveals the spell’s normal information and ends the effect.
/wondrous-items:blasted-goggles: The goggles have 3 charges and regain 1d3 at dawn. Spend 1 as an action to target a visible creature within 120 feet: DC 15 Dexterity save or 3d6 fire damage. Curse: you cannot remove or end attunement without Remove Curse or similar magic; a natural 20 on the target’s save blinds you for 24 hours.
/wondrous-items:bloodrage-greataxe: Gain +2 to attack and damage rolls with this greataxe while at half your hit points or fewer.
/wondrous-items:bottled-breath: Inhale the bottled air and choose to exhale it for Gust of Wind or hold it to avoid breathing for 1 hour. Ending the held breath early gives no wind effect.
/wondrous-items:card-sharps-deck: While holding the deck, use an action to throw a spectral card as a Dexterity-based ranged spell attack at up to 120 feet; it deals 1d8 force damage on a hit. Alternatively, cast Spray of Cards at 3rd level, save DC 15, once per dawn.
/wondrous-items:cracked-driftglobe: While within 60 feet, speak the command word to make the globe produce the Light spell.
/wondrous-items:deck-of-wonder: Declare a number of cards before drawing; each must follow the previous draw within 1 hour or the remaining draws occur together. Cards normally take effect and return to the deck, allowing repeats. The 13- or 22-card deck grants mixed benefits and penalties, including temporary bonuses, resistance, magic items, damage, curses and brief confinement. Consult the individual card effects.
/wondrous-items:dragons-wrath-weapon: The dragon’s breath determines the damage type. A natural 20 deals 5 damage of that type to chosen creatures within 5 feet of the target. Stirring grants +1 and 1d6 extra damage; Wakened +2 and 2d6 plus a once-per-dawn 30-foot cone (DC 16 Dexterity, 8d6, half on success); Ascendant increases these to +3, 3d6, a 60-foot cone, DC 18, and 12d6.
/wondrous-items:driftglobe: Within 60 feet, command the globe to cast Light or Daylight; Daylight recharges at dawn. Another command as an action makes it hover up to 5 feet above ground. It follows when you move beyond 60 feet, but settles and goes dark if blocked.
/wondrous-items:earworm: This symbiont burrows behind your ear during attunement, granting Deep Speech. It has 4 charges and regains 1d4 at dawn; cast Dissonant Whispers for 1 or Detect Thoughts for 2 (DC 15). Thoughts learned are relayed to a daelkyr. You cannot voluntarily detach or end attunement; curse-ending magic releases it.
/wondrous-items:fabulist-gem: As an action, create up to 100 gp in illusory coins within 10 feet, once per dawn; they vanish after 1 hour. As a bonus action, alter the appearance of worn clothing and armor, though physical inspection reveals the illusion.
/wondrous-items:gloves-of-thievery: The worn gloves are invisible and give +5 to Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) checks and Dexterity checks to pick locks.
/wondrous-items:guild-keyrune: Use an action and command word to transform the keyrune in an unoccupied space within 5 feet into its guild-specific creature. It is friendly, understands your languages and follows commands; otherwise it Dodges and avoids danger. It reverts at 0 HP, at its duration’s end, or by command while touched, then cannot transform for 36 hours. Creature forms, durations and special abilities vary by guild.
/wondrous-items:hellfire-weapon: The weapon sheds dim light for 5 feet. A humanoid killed by its attack has its soul sent to the River Styx and immediately becomes a lemure devil.
/wondrous-items:infernal-puzzle-box: An object placed inside seals the box, making it immune to damage and impossible to open magically. A creature can spend 1 hour and attempt DC 30 Intelligence (Investigation) to learn its mundane opening trick; once known, opening takes an action. Failing by 5 or more triggers a DC 18 Wisdom save against 12d6 psychic damage, half on success.
/wondrous-items:instrument-of-the-bards: An attuned bard can use an action to play and cast an available spell, with each spell recharging at dawn and using the bard’s spellcasting ability and save DC. All versions grant Fly, Invisibility, Levitate and Protection from Evil and Good; other spells vary by instrument. Playing while casting an eligible charm spell imposes disadvantage on its saves. An unattuned player risks 2d4 psychic damage on a failed DC 15 Wisdom save.
/wondrous-items:mariners-armor: While worn, gain a swimming speed equal to your walking speed. Starting your turn underwater at 0 hit points causes the armor to raise you 60 feet toward the surface.
/wondrous-items:mizzium-apparatus: Use the harness as an arcane focus and attempt a class-list spell you do not know or have prepared, using a slot and components normally. Make an Intelligence (Arcana) check against 10 plus twice the slot level; failure casts a random spell from the corresponding table, using the fifth-level table for slots 6 or higher. An unknown cantrip uses DC 10 and has no effect on failure.
/wondrous-items:natures-mantle: Use the cloak as a focus for druid and ranger spells. In light obscurement you may Hide as a bonus action even while directly observed.
/wondrous-items:piwafwi: This drow cloak functions as a Cloak of Elvenkind, but loses its magic after 1 continuous hour of sunlight exposure.
/wondrous-items:portal-compass: The needle points toward the last portal the compass passed through while both remain on the same plane. If that portal ceases to exist, it remains still until the compass passes through another.
/wondrous-items:potion-of-polychromy: For 1 hour after drinking, you and your possessions become rainbow colored. Change colors as a bonus action; matching your surroundings grants advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks until you change colors again or the potion ends.
/wondrous-items:prismari-primer: The primer has 3 charges and recovers 1d3 at dawn. After rolling an Acrobatics or Performance check while holding it, spend 1 charge for +1d4. Study it after a long rest to choose a 1st-level bard or sorcerer spell; cast that spell once without a slot while holding it before the next long rest, using Intelligence, Wisdom or Charisma.
/wondrous-items:pyroconverger: As an action, project a 10-foot cone: creatures make a DC 13 Dexterity save against 4d6 fire damage, half on success. Each use requires a d10 roll plus uses since your last long rest; at 11 or higher it malfunctions, dealing 4d6 fire damage to you and becoming unusable until a long rest.
/wondrous-items:ring-of-obscuring: The ring has 3 charges and regains 1d3 at dawn. Spend 1 as an action to cast Fog Cloud centered on yourself, lasting 1 minute without concentration.
/wondrous-items:ring-of-truth-telling: While wearing it, gain advantage on Wisdom (Insight) checks to tell whether someone is lying.
/wondrous-items:rod-of-retribution: The rod has 3 charges and recovers all at dawn. When a creature you can see within 60 feet damages you, spend 1 charge as a reaction to force a DC 13 Dexterity save against 2d10 lightning damage, half on success.
/wondrous-items:scaled-ornament: Slumbering grants advantage on saves against being charmed or frightened. Stirring grants +1 AC, immunity to those conditions, and allies of your choice within 30 feet gain advantage on related saves. Wakened adds a once-per-dawn reaction to negate the associated dragon breath damage and heal that amount. Ascendant also grants a flying speed equal to walking speed and hover.
/wondrous-items:sensory-stone: Touch the stone as an action to experience its stored fleeting, harmless sensation. As a reaction record a sensation of up to 6 seconds experienced by a creature within 30 feet, replacing the prior one. As a bonus action, destroy it to end your charmed or frightened condition.
/wondrous-items:shatterspike: This weapon grants +1 to attack and damage rolls. Hits against objects automatically critically hit and can deal bludgeoning or slashing damage. Nonmagical damage cannot harm the weapon.
/wondrous-items:silverquill-primer: The primer has 3 charges and regains 1d3 at dawn. After rolling Intimidation or Persuasion while holding it, spend 1 charge for +1d4. Study it after a long rest to choose a 1st-level bard or cleric spell; cast it once without a slot while holding the primer before the next long rest, using Intelligence, Wisdom or Charisma.
/wondrous-items:smokepowder: A packet supplies five firearm shots and a keg 500. Fire or rough handling detonates it: creatures and objects within 20 feet take 1d6 fire damage per packet or 9d6 per keg, halved by a DC 12 Dexterity save. Dispel Magic makes the powder permanently inert.
/wondrous-items:spies-murmur: Communicate telepathically with a known wearer of another murmur within 1 mile. As a bonus action, let that wearer hear what you hear for 1 hour; end it as a bonus action, or it ends if you are incapacitated.
/wondrous-items:stone-of-ill-luck: The stone appears to be and grants the benefits of a Stone of Good Luck, but secretly imposes −2 to ability checks and saving throws. Its curse prevents you from willingly parting with it until Remove Curse or similar magic breaks the curse.
/wondrous-items:thessaltoxin-antidote: Drinking this antidote ends the Polymorph effect caused by thessaltoxin.
/wondrous-items:weapon-of-warning: While carrying the weapon, gain advantage on initiative. You and companions within 30 feet cannot be surprised unless incapacitated by something other than natural sleep. It also wakes you and nearby companions from natural sleep when combat starts.
/wondrous-items:winged-ammunition: Attacks using this ammunition ignore half and three-quarters cover and do not suffer disadvantage for long range.
/wondrous-items:wraps-of-unarmed-prowess: Your unarmed strikes count as magical against resistance and immunity to nonmagical attacks and damage. They gain +1, +2, or +3 to attack and damage according to rarity.
/wondrous-items:amulet-of-protection-fro: While worn, gain advantage on saves against effects that turn undead. Three times per dawn, choose to succeed instead when you fail such a save.
/wondrous-items:atlas-of-endless-horizon: The book contains the listed teleportation spells and serves as a wizard spellbook and focus. It has 3 charges and regains 1d3 at dawn. Spend 1 charge and 1 minute to replace a prepared wizard spell with a conjuration spell in the book, or spend 1 as a reaction when hit to teleport up to 10 feet to a visible unoccupied space; the attack misses if you move out of range.
/wondrous-items:battering-shield: Gain +1 AC in addition to the shield’s normal bonus. It has 3 charges, recovering 1d3 at dawn. When you push a creature in reach at least 5 feet, spend 1 charge to push it another 10 feet, knock it prone, or both.
/wondrous-items:bonecounter: This +2 mace creates one silver piece in your pocket whenever it destroys an undead creature.
/wondrous-items:bracers-of-celerity: While worn, increase all your speeds by 10 feet and gain advantage on saves to avoid or end the paralyzed or restrained condition.
/wondrous-items:butchers-bib: Once per turn, reroll the weapon damage dice of a melee weapon attack and use the new total. Your weapon attacks dealing slashing damage score a critical hit on a 19 or 20.
/wondrous-items:chromatic-rose: While holding the stem, gain resistance to the rose’s color-associated damage. If more than 10 damage of that type remains after resistance from one source, the rose disintegrates and negates that damage. As an action destroy it to create a 20-foot cone: DC 15 Constitution save or 3d10 of its damage type, half on success.
/wondrous-items:corpse-slayer: Gain +1 to attack and damage rolls. A hit on an undead creature deals an extra 1d8 damage of the weapon’s type and gives it disadvantage on saves against turning until your next turn begins.
/wondrous-items:dagger-of-blindsight: While attuned to this dagger, you gain blindsight with a 30-foot range.
/wondrous-items:demon-skin: Attunement causes the ichor to become armor on your skin; it can be worn under clothing. It grants poison resistance and does not impose Stealth disadvantage. It stays on until you choose to remove it or die, when its container reappears.
/wondrous-items:dodecahedron-of-doom: Throw the die up to 60 feet as an action; after it rolls at least 10 feet, roll d12 for an effect. Outcomes include Light, Darkness for 10 minutes, Ray of Frost or Shocking Grasp at +5, or 1d10 temporary HP for an hour. On 1–2 it explodes and is destroyed: creatures within 20 feet make a DC 13 Dexterity save against 9d8 force damage, half on success.
/wondrous-items:dragontooth-dagger: Gain +1 to attack and damage and deal an extra 1d6 acid on a hit. Against enemies of the Cult of the Dragon these increase to +2 and 2d6 acid.
/wondrous-items:elemental-essence-shard: Attach to or detach from a Tiny object as an action; the shard falls off when attunement ends and can serve as a spellcasting focus. Using Metamagic while holding or wearing it triggers its elemental property: flight up to 60 feet, temporary damage resistance, 2d10 delayed fire damage, or a 10-foot wave dealing 2d6 cold and potentially pushing and knocking creatures prone.
/wondrous-items:fate-dealers-deck: While held, the deck is a focus and grants +1, +2, or +3 to spell attacks and save DC by rarity. As an action expend and roll a Hit Die, add that bonus, and cause a visible creature within 30 feet either to regain that many hit points or take that much radiant damage.
/wondrous-items:flayer-slayer: This greataxe gives +1 to attack and damage. An aberration hit takes an extra 1d12 slashing damage; if it is grappling anyone, it must make a DC 15 Strength save or release all creatures it grapples.
/wondrous-items:galders-bubble-pipe: The pipe has 3 charges and recovers all at dawn. Spend 1 to cast Fog Cloud as an action, 2 to cast Misty Step as a bonus action, or 3 as an action to summon a friendly, obedient steam mephit. It lasts 1 minute or disappears if it ends its turn more than 60 feet from the pipe.
/wondrous-items:gavel-of-the-venn-rune: Before your first turn in combat, attacks against you have disadvantage while you carry it. Once per long rest, strike a surface as an action; the next creature within 60 feet that hits another with an attack within 1 minute takes psychic damage equal to half the damage dealt. Eight hours of work destroys the gavel to create a permanent 30-foot-radius area where lying causes 5 psychic damage and a visible flinch.
/wondrous-items:glimmering-moonbow: The bow grants +1 to attack and damage and deals an extra 1d6 radiant damage on a ranged hit. It creates magic ammunition if unloaded, which vanishes after the attack. Once per dawn, use a bonus action to gain resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage until your next turn starts.
/wondrous-items:grasping-whip: The whip grants +1 to attack and damage. Instead of dealing damage on a hit, pull a Large or smaller creature or object 5 feet toward you.
/wondrous-items:hell-hound-cloak: As an action transform into a hell hound for up to 1 hour as Polymorph, with a bonus action to revert. The curse prevents you willingly parting with the cloak. Starting with the sixth transformation, a failed DC 15 Charisma save prevents voluntary reversion until dispelled or reduced to 0 HP. Six hours transformed makes it permanent; after six days only Wish reverses it. See the curse details.
/wondrous-items:horn-of-the-endless-maze: Blow as an action to summon 3d4 + 3 berserker spirits within 60 feet for 1 hour or until reduced to 0 HP. They obey you if you are proficient with all simple weapons; otherwise they attack you. Recharges after 7 days.
/wondrous-items:knaves-eye-patch: Gain advantage on sight-based Perception checks and ignore Sunlight Sensitivity. Other creatures cannot magically read your thoughts or determine whether you lie, and can communicate telepathically with you only with your permission.
/wondrous-items:libram-of-souls-and-fles: The book serves as a wizard spellbook and focus and contains the listed necromancy spells. It has 3 charges and regains 1d3 at dawn. Spend 1 charge and 1 minute to replace a prepared wizard spell with a necromancy spell in it, or 1 charge as an action to appear undead for 10 minutes. Undead are indifferent unless damaged; the disguise ends if you deal damage or force a save.
/wondrous-items:lyre-of-building: While held, cast Mending as an action. As a reaction to visible object or structure damage within 300 feet, make it immune to that damage and the same damage type until your next turn starts. Cast Fabricate, Move Earth, Passwall, or Summon Construct as an action; each recharges at dawn.
/wondrous-items:mind-lash: In a mind flayer’s hands, the whip adds 2d4 psychic damage on a hit. A creature taking that psychic damage must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom save or have disadvantage on Intelligence, Wisdom and Charisma saves for 1 minute, repeating the save at each turn’s end. For others it is an ordinary whip.
/wondrous-items:mizzium-mortar: The mortar has 4 charges and regains 1d4 at dawn. Spend 1 as an action for a 30-foot cone dealing 5d4 fire, or 3 for a 20-foot-radius, 40-foot-high cylinder within 60 feet dealing 5d8 fire. Each allows a DC 15 Dexterity save for half damage.
/wondrous-items:opal-of-the-ild-rune: While carrying the opal, gain cold resistance and use an action to ignite a small flammable area or extinguish open flames within 10 feet. Eight hours of work destroys it to enchant a nonmagical weapon with +1d6 fire damage on hits, or armor that grants cold resistance and requires attunement.
/wondrous-items:pariahs-shield: The shield grants +1 AC for every two allies within 5 feet, maximum +3, in addition to its normal AC bonus. When a visible creature within 5 feet takes damage, use your reaction to take it instead as force damage.
/wondrous-items:potion-of-aqueous-form: For 10 minutes you become water, ending early if incapacitated or killed. You swim 30 feet, pass through Tiny openings and other creatures’ spaces, and extinguish nonmagical flames entered. Gain resistance to nonmagical damage and advantage on Strength, Dexterity and Constitution saves. You cannot speak, attack, cast spells or activate items; carried equipment melds and is inaccessible.
/wondrous-items:potion-of-mind-control: Before the end of your next turn after drinking, cast the potion’s Dominate Beast, Person, or Monster spell on an eligible target (DC 15), or waste the potion. On an initial failed save, the effect lasts 1 hour without concentration and the target has disadvantage on subsequent saves to end it.
/wondrous-items:revelers-concertina: While holding it, gain +2 to the save DC of your bard spells. Cast Otto’s Irresistible Dance as an action once per dawn.
/wondrous-items:rod-of-the-vonindod: The 100-pound rod has 10 charges and regains 1d6 + 4 at dawn. Grasp its handle and spend 1 charge as an action to cast Locate Object; its range becomes 10 miles when detecting adamantine objects.
/wondrous-items:sages-signet: Cast Augury once per dawn. Each signet also grants two specific spells, each usable once per dawn with Intelligence as the spellcasting ability; see the signet table.
/wondrous-items:scorpion-armor: This plate grants +5 initiative while you are not incapacitated and does not impose disadvantage on Stealth or saves against extreme heat. Curse: each time you don or doff it, make a DC 15 Constitution save against 10d10 + 45 poison damage, half on success. Only Wish removes the curse.
/wondrous-items:shadowfell-brand-tattoo: While attuned, gain darkvision 60 feet and advantage on Stealth checks. Once per sunset, use a reaction when damaged to halve the damage. Ending attunement removes the tattoo and restores its needle.
/wondrous-items:shield-of-far-sight: Its mind flayer creator can see through the eye, which has 60-foot darkvision, while on the same plane, and can use Mind Blast as though behind the shield. Destroying the shield blinds its creator for 2d12 hours.
/wondrous-items:spelljamming-helm: An attuned seated spellcaster concentrating can steer a ship of at least 1 ton through space, air, or suitable water. In space with no other object of at least 1 ton within 1 mile, it travels 100 million miles per day. The pilot can perceive from any point aboard and use an action to transfer attunement to a willing spellcaster.
/wondrous-items:staff-of-ruling: Each of three effects recharges at dawn: create a concentrated lightning orb within 60 feet, movable 20 feet by bonus action, detonating for 6d6–10d6 lightning in a 20-foot radius (DC 15 Dexterity, half); transform the staff into a commanded giant poisonous snake; or force chosen creatures within 30 feet to make a DC 15 Constitution save or be deafened and frightened until your next turn ends.
/wondrous-items:starshot-crossbow: Ignore loading; the crossbow creates vanishing magic ammunition if unloaded. It has 3 charges and regains 1d3 at dawn. Spend 1 as a bonus action for a constellation: next hit heals a chosen creature within 30 feet for 1d8 + proficiency; hits deal +2d8 fire; or you and your possessions become invisible. Effects expire at the end of your next turn.
/wondrous-items:sunforger: This +2 weapon can be hurled as an action up to 120 feet, exploding in a 20-foot radius for 6d6 fire damage (DC 15 Dexterity save for half). Recall it to an empty hand as an action; explosion recharges after a short or long rest. If not recalled, it reappears after 24 hours or when attunement ends.
/wondrous-items:two-birds-sling: This sling grants +1 to attack and damage. After a ranged hit, ricochet the ammunition and make another ranged attack against a second target within 10 feet of the first.
/wondrous-items:wand-of-viscid-globs: The wand has 7 charges and recovers 1d6 + 1 at midnight. Spend 1 as an action for a ranged attack against a creature within 60 feet, using spellcasting ability or Intelligence plus proficiency. A hit restrains for 1 hour; alcohol, Oil of Etherealness, Universal Solvent, or sunlight dissolves the glob. Last charge risks destruction on a d20 roll of 1; an hour of continuous sunlight destroys the wand.
/wondrous-items:warriors-passkey: In key form, cast Knock as an action. As a bonus action transform it into a magic longsword with which you are proficient, granting +1 to attack and damage and dealing 1d10 force on a hit. It reverts when released, attunement ends, or you use another bonus action.
/wondrous-items:weird-tank: Open the worn tank as an action to release its water weird, which acts after you and follows telepathic commands. Close it only once the weird is withdrawn or dead. A dead weird is replaced after the tank spends 24 hours in an elemental water node. The tank has AC 15, 50 HP, bludgeoning vulnerability and poison/psychic immunity; destruction also destroys its occupant.
/wondrous-items:abracadabrus: The empty chest has 20 charges and regains 1d20 at dawn. Touch its closed lid as an action and spend 1 charge to create nonmagical objects worth at most 1 gp total that fit inside the empty compartment. Food spoils after 24 hours; created precious metals and gems vanish after 1 minute. Spending the last charge risks permanent loss of magic on a d20 roll of 1.
/wondrous-items:amulet-of-the-black-skul: The amulet has 6 charges and recovers 1d6 at dawn. Spend 1 as an action to teleport yourself and your possessions to a familiar same-plane location within 100 feet, even outside sight. If not undead, make a DC 16 Constitution save or roll a harmful transformation: possible effects include inability to heal magically, size change, scattered equipment, paralysis, or petrification.
/wondrous-items:arcane-propulsion-arm: This attuned prosthetic replaces a missing arm or part of one and cannot be removed against your will. You can remove it as an action. It is a proficient magic melee weapon dealing 1d8 force with thrown range 20/60; when thrown, it immediately returns and reattaches.
/wondrous-items:battle-standard-of-infer: While you hold the banner, your and allied creatures’ weapon attacks within 300 feet count as magical against resistance and immunity. Its caged quasit is incapacitated and replaced if killed or released while the cage remains intact. The cage has AC 19, 10 HP and immunity to damage except force.
/wondrous-items:bloodaxe: This axe grants +2 to attack and damage and adds 1d6 necrotic damage against creatures other than constructs or undead. Reducing such a creature to 0 HP with it grants 10 temporary hit points.
/wondrous-items:bobbing-lily-pad: This 10-foot floating leaf moves on land, water, or through air at 20 feet and can hover. While riding, direct it by voice. It carries 300 pounds normally or up to 600 pounds at half speed.
/wondrous-items:cape-of-enlargement: The cape has 3 charges and recovers 1d3 at dawn. Spend 1 as a bonus action to grow one size category as space permits for 10 minutes: gain advantage on Strength checks and saves and add proficiency bonus to weapon and unarmed attack damage. Dismiss as a bonus action.
/wondrous-items:chronolometer: Gain +1 to Intelligence saves and learn one language chosen upon first attunement. Once per dawn, roll d6 at your turn’s start for either an extra action and doubled speed that turn or a future reroll of one failed save, attack, or check. Separately once per dawn, react to damage to a visible creature within 30 feet to grant it an action. Outside the Orrery, effects can be unpredictable.
/wondrous-items:constantoris-portrait: This sentient lawful evil painting hears within 120 feet, sees in darkvision 60 feet ahead, speaks three languages, and remembers information at the DM’s discretion. While attuned, contact it telepathically on the same plane with an action and concentration. It can guard designated enemies with Magic Missile, using 3 charges restored at dawn. It has AC 12 and 20 HP; Mending restores 2d6 HP if not destroyed.
/wondrous-items:deck-of-dimensions: The deck has 6 charges and regains 1d6 at dawn. Spend 1 as a bonus action to mark a nearby card for later teleportation, or throw a card to teleport to an unoccupied space within 60 feet. Spend 3 as an action to cast Arcane Gate. The marked card returns after teleportation or 8 hours; source text also specifies use within 24 hours.
/wondrous-items:dimensional-loop: Gain +1 Strength saves and darkvision 60 feet, or extend existing darkvision by 30 feet. Once per dawn as a bonus action phase for 1 minute, gaining advantage on Stealth checks to hide and imposing disadvantage on attacks against you. Separately once per dawn treat a visible space within 60 feet as within 5 feet until your turn ends, permitting movement without opportunity attacks or interaction. Outside the Orrery effects may be unpredictable.
/wondrous-items:dyrrns-tentacle-whip: This symbiotic whip gives +2 to attack and damage, adds 1d6 psychic on a hit, and stuns until the target’s next turn ends on a natural 20. Attacks against aberrations have disadvantage. Retract or draw it as a bonus action. You cannot remove it or voluntarily end attunement; curse-ending magic detaches it.
/wondrous-items:fate-cutter-shears: These magic dagger shears add 1d6 force damage on a hit. Once per dawn, a hit can make attacks against the target score critical hits on 19–20 until it finishes a long rest.
/wondrous-items:fools-blade: This +2 weapon can feint as a bonus action once per dawn, granting advantage on attacks against a creature within 5 feet until your next turn. Separately once per dawn, react to an attack targeting you from within 60 feet; on a failed DC 15 Intelligence save, redirect it to another creature within the attacker’s reach.
/wondrous-items:hammer-of-runic-focus: The hammer has 3 charges and regains 1d3 at dawn. Spend 1 as a bonus action to create a 15-foot-radius rune circle for 1 minute. While inside it, gain +3 to attack and damage with the hammer. A new circle or bonus-action dismissal ends the old one.
/wondrous-items:horned-ring: While attuned and wearing the ring, ignore the magical restrictions specific to Undermountain; consult the location’s alterations to magic.
/wondrous-items:ingot-of-the-skold-rune: While carried, gain +1 AC. Once per short or long rest, use a bonus action to protect another visible creature within 30 feet until your next turn ends: damage to it is reduced to 1, and you take half the prevented damage without reduction. Eight hours of work destroys the ingot to enchant a shield or two-handed melee weapon with the listed defensive benefits.
/wondrous-items:lifewell-tattoo: Gain resistance to necrotic damage. Once per dawn, when reduced to 0 HP, drop to 1 instead. Ending attunement makes the tattoo disappear and its needle reappear.
/wondrous-items:lucent-destroyer: This +1 musket needs no ammunition, ignores loading, and deals radiant instead of piercing damage. While attuned, cast Dancing Lights at will. Once per dawn invoke its rune as an action to cast Sunbeam (DC 17).
/wondrous-items:mirror-of-reflected-past: Activate the upright mirror with an action and command word; it hovers immovably until deactivated or attunement ends, and recharges at dawn after deactivation. A non-construct other than you seeing its reflection within 30 feet must make a DC 15 Wisdom save or be paralyzed while it can see the mirror; repeat at each turn’s end. A successful or ended effect grants 24-hour immunity.
/wondrous-items:navigation-orb: Touch the orb and use an action to move its keyed cloud castle at 1 mph, stop it, or turn it 90 degrees. The castle lands gently on contact with the ground. Anyone touching the orb knows the castle’s altitude. If the orb is removed or destroyed, the castle remains fixed until it is returned or replaced.
/wondrous-items:ornithopter-of-flying: This vehicle flies at 30 feet under its rider’s spoken direction, with a maximum rider-and-gear weight of 300 pounds. It cannot hover. If it loses its rider in flight, it falls and cannot fly for 1d6 + 4 days.
/wondrous-items:polymorph-blade: On a natural 20 against a creature, it must make a DC 15 Wisdom save or be polymorphed into a randomly determined form. Shapechangers, creatures with legendary actions, and creatures immune to its damage type are immune. Curse: you will not part with it; a natural 1 on an attack polymorphs you for 1 hour. Remove Curse or similar magic breaks the curse.
/wondrous-items:potion-of-vitality: Drinking removes all exhaustion and cures diseases and poisons affecting you. For 24 hours, regain the maximum possible hit points from each Hit Die you spend.
/wondrous-items:ring-of-red-fury: While worn, breathe water and gain a swimming speed equal to walking speed. Once per long rest, use a bonus action for 1 minute of Strength check/save advantage, proficiency bonus to attack damage, ignoring difficult terrain, and immunity to paralyzed and restrained. Activating requires a DC 20 Charisma save; failure causes one exhaustion level and ruidium corruption. If ruidium is destroyed, the ring becomes a Ring of Free Action.
/wondrous-items:ruidium-armor: While worn, gain psychic resistance, breathe water and swim at your walking speed. Rolling a 1 on a saving throw requires a DC 15 Charisma save; failure causes one exhaustion level and ruidium corruption. If ruidium is destroyed, the armor becomes +1 Armor.
/wondrous-items:sanctum-amulet: Gain necrotic resistance and cast Spare the Dying as an action or bonus action. Once per dawn, when a visible creature within 60 feet is reduced to 0 HP by damage, use your reaction to leave it at 1 HP instead.
/wondrous-items:shield-of-the-uven-rune: While holding the shield, gain cold immunity and react to a melee hit by dealing 3d6 necrotic damage to the attacker. Cast Bane (DC 17) for 1 minute without concentration once per short or long rest. Eight hours of work destroys the shield to create an attunement-required +1 weapon, increasing to +3 against one chosen creature type.
/wondrous-items:speaking-stone: A gnome with the Mark of Scribing can touch the stone and use an action to cast Sending to another speaking stone whose location or unique symbols are known. Creatures within 5 feet of the receiving stone hear the message.
/wondrous-items:staff-of-fate: This +3 quarterstaff has 6 charges. Spend 1 as a bonus action to give yourself or another visible creature a d4 to add to one check, attack, damage roll, or save before your next turn. On spending the last charge, roll d20: 9 or lower makes it nonmagical and breaks it on its next damaging hit; 10 or higher restores 1d6 charges.
/wondrous-items:sun-pellet: Crack or throw the pellet up to 100 feet as an action to produce the equivalent of Sunburst with a 20-foot radius and DC 15 save.
/wondrous-items:thunderbuss: This +1 pistol needs no ammunition, ignores loading, and deals thunder rather than piercing damage. Once per dawn as a bonus action, create a 10-foot-radius blast at a visible point within 30 feet: DC 14 Constitution save or 3d6 thunder and no reactions until your next turn ends; success halves damage only.
/wondrous-items:voyager-staff: This +1 quarterstaff gives +1 to spell attacks while held. It has 10 charges and regains 1d6 + 4 at dawn. Cast Banishment (4), Blink (3), Misty Step (2), Passwall (5), or Teleport (7), using your spell save DC. Spending the last charge causes it to vanish on a d20 roll of 1.
/wondrous-items:wheel-of-stars: Gain +1 Wisdom saves and cast Dancing Lights, Guidance, or Message as an action. Once per dawn, react to a visible creature’s attack, save, or check within 60 feet to add or subtract 1d10. Separately once per dawn, cast Fly on yourself or Levitate (DC 15). Outside the Orrery its magic can be unpredictable.
/wondrous-items:belashyrras-beholder-cro: The symbiotic crown grants sight through magical and nonmagical darkness to 120 feet. Its 10 charges recover 1d6 + 3 at dawn; spend charges as an action on its listed spells, using DC 16. You cannot remove it or voluntarily end attunement; curse-ending magic detaches it. Belashyrra can see through it while on the same plane.
/wondrous-items:blackstaff: This sentient Staff of Power can choose its rightful wielder. In Waterdeep, spend a charge per walking statue to animate or deactivate it; its trapped spirit commands them. Spend charges to cast Dispel Magic by touch or drain a target’s highest spell slot after a melee hit. An Arcana check (DC 10 + spell level) can cast an enchantment spell without a slot. Former wielders’ spirits are trapped inside; consult the staff’s full sentience and destruction rules.
/wondrous-items:cloak-of-invisibility: Raise or lower the hood as an action to become invisible or visible; worn and carried items also become invisible. It provides 2 hours total, tracked in 1-minute increments, and recovers 1 hour per uninterrupted 12 hours unused.
/wondrous-items:deck-of-many-more-things: Declare your number of random draws first and draw each within 1 hour of the previous one, or remaining cards take effect together. Cards generally return to the deck after taking effect, allowing repeats. The 44 additional cards can grant powerful benefits or inflict serious harms including death, imprisonment, loss of equipment and curses. Consult each card’s effect; the deck can be combined with the Deck of Many Things.
/wondrous-items:dragonlance: This pike or lance grants +3 to attack and damage. On a hit against a dragon, deal an extra 3d6 force damage and let a dragon you can see within 30 feet use its reaction to make a melee attack.
/wondrous-items:efreeti-chain: This armor grants +3 AC and fire immunity, lets you speak and understand Primordial, and allows walking on molten rock as solid ground.
/wondrous-items:fedifensor: A lawful good wielder gains +1; a lawful good paladin gains +3, advantage on saves against magic, and can dispel magic on self or sword. The paladin can use Divine Sense without expending uses; the sword glows near fiends or undead and adds 1d8 radiant against demons, with another 1d8 on Divine Smite. A non-lawful-good creature touching the unsheathed sentient sword takes 3d6 psychic damage and one exhaustion level.
/wondrous-items:grimoire-infinitus: This infinite-page wizard spellbook contains the listed spells. Preparing from it grants one extra prepared wizard spell when dormant, two when awakened, or three when exalted. Awakened also grants advantage on saves against spells and magic while carried; exalted permits Arcane Recovery twice per long rest.
