/wondrous-items:harp-of-gilded-plenty: To attune, succeed on DC 15 Performance or DC 20 Persuasion; failure prevents another attempt until dawn. Treat Charisma check d20 rolls of 9 or less as 10. Play for 10 minutes to cast Heroes’ Feast once per 1d10 + 10 days. Cast Calm Emotions (DC 19) as an action up to five times per dawn, concentrating for up to 1 hour. The harp is sentient.
/wondrous-items:helm-of-the-scavenger: On a 1–100 ton vessel in space, the helm provides breathable air and artificial gravity. An attuned seated spellcaster steers and moves through water at mph equal to the highest unspent spell slot, or through air/space at ten times that speed, and can see from any location aboard. While attuned, the pilot cannot expend their own spell slots.
/wondrous-items:hither-thither-staff: The staff has 4 charges and regains 1d4 at dawn. Spend 1 as an action to create or relocate two linked portals on visible flat surfaces within 1,500 feet. Creatures and objects pass between them; they last 24 hours or until more than 1 mile apart. While holding the staff, close both or suppress one as a bonus action.
/wondrous-items:icon-of-ravenloft: Creatures within 30 feet receive Protection from Evil and Good against fiends and undead. An attuned user can cast Augury once per dawn, increase Turn Undead or Turn the Unholy save DC by 2 using it as a holy symbol, and once per dawn heal a visible creature within 30 feet for 3d8 + 3 HP, excluding undead, constructs and fiends.
/wondrous-items:ironfang: This +2 war pick adds 1d8 thunder on a hit. While held, speak Terran, gain acid resistance and 60-foot tremorsense, and sense precious metals and stones within 60 feet. Cast Dominate Monster on an earth elemental (DC 17) once per dawn. Its 3 charges recover 1d3 at dawn and cast Shatter (DC 17) for 1 each. It can create a devastation orb in an earth node and imposes a destructive flaw.
/wondrous-items:korolnor-scepter: This +3 magic club permits use of the Wyrmskull Throne’s properties. It has 10 charges and recovers 1d6 + 4 at dawn. Spend charges as an action to learn distance to the surface underground or underwater (1), cast Sending (2), or Teleport (3); teleporting within 60 feet of the throne cannot mishap.
/wondrous-items:luxon-beacon: Touch and concentrate for 1 minute to gain a Fragment of Possibility for 8 hours, once per dawn. Spend it for an additional d20 on your attack, check or save, or an attack against you, and choose the result after advantage or disadvantage is resolved. A consecuted Luxon follower dying within 100 miles has their soul captured for reincarnation in a nearby humanoid baby.
/wondrous-items:murgaxor-s-orb: This sentient evil orb can independently cast Suggestion (DC 17) on a recent toucher. Humanoids you touch while holding it make a DC 10 Wisdom save or become cursed; the orb can make cursed creatures unconscious for 1 hour or attack non-cursed creatures for 10 minutes, ending their curse afterward. Remove Curse also ends it. The orb has AC 18, 20 HP, necrotic/poison/psychic immunity and resistance to other damage.
/wondrous-items:nightbringer: This +3 mace deals an extra 4d4 radiant damage. An evil attuned wielder also gains immunity to charmed and frightened, immunity to one chosen elemental damage type, and darkvision 60 feet or an extra 60 feet. It has 6 charges, regaining 1d6 at dawn; spend 1 on a hit to force a DC 20 Constitution save or blind until your next turn.
/wondrous-items:orb-of-skoraeus: While holding this focus, gain +2 to Constitution saves to maintain spell concentration and see through magical and nonmagical darkness to 120 feet. It has 3 charges, all restored at dawn; expend up to 3 when casting to ignore material components costing up to 300 gp per charge.
/wondrous-items:potion-of-dragons-majest: Drink to become an adult dragon matching the suspended scale for 1 hour. Use its statistics while retaining your personality, memories and languages; equipment melds or falls at your choice. You cannot use its Change Shape, legendary actions or lair actions.
/wondrous-items:pyxis-of-pandemonium: Touch for 1 minute to gain a short rest and Bless until your next rest, once per long rest. A DC 17 Wisdom save prevents a 1-hour compulsion to open it. Opening triggers a random calamity, using spell save DC 17, including harmful spells or hostile shadow demons. It vanishes after 1 minute and reappears sealed elsewhere on the same plane 24 hours later.
/wondrous-items:red-wizard-blade: A melee hit with this dagger deals an extra 3d12 necrotic damage. A creature reduced to 0 HP by it dies and can be raised only by a deity or True Resurrection cast using a tablet of reawakening.
/wondrous-items:ruinblade: This sentient +2 weapon adds 1d8 force against undead. Cast Blight (DC 15) once per dawn and Disintegrate on a nonmagical object or magical force once per seven dawns. Its curse prevents willingly parting with it; unless it helps destroy 1,000 gp in objects every seven days, conflict with the weapon results.
/wondrous-items:shard-solitaire: As a bonus action teleport up to 30 feet to a visible unoccupied space, or up to 60 feet with a DC 16 Constitution save against 3d10 force damage if you exceed 30 feet. The stone has 6 charges and recovers 1d6 at dawn; cast its listed spells as an action without material components, DC 16. All variants offer Banishment and Mirror Image.
/wondrous-items:snicker-snack: This sentient +3 vorpal greatsword ignores slashing resistance and can use Charisma for attack and damage. A natural 20 severs a head, or deals 6d8 extra slashing against an immune creature. Three consecutive misses end attunement; regain it only by winning a contested Charisma check after a long rest.
/wondrous-items:stonebreakers-breastplat: Gain resistance to bludgeoning, piercing and slashing damage and immunity to being knocked prone. Once per dawn, cast Wall of Stone (DC 14) as an action and gain advantage on saves to maintain its concentration.
/wondrous-items:sword-of-answering: This +3 sword permits a reaction attack with advantage against a creature in reach that damages you. Damage from that reaction attack ignores the target’s resistance and immunity. Each sword has its own alignment.
/wondrous-items:talarith: A reigar wearing this jewelry adds 1d6 force damage to its weapon hits. As an action it can summon a construct duplicate using its own statistics without the jewelry; the duplicate obeys it and lasts 1 hour or until 0 HP. Recharges after a short or long rest.
/wondrous-items:tome-of-the-stilled-tong: This tome serves as a spellbook and arcane focus. Once per dawn, while holding it, cast a spell written in it as a bonus action without a slot or verbal or somatic components. Removing its tongue permanently erases its spells. Vecna can observe its user and leave messages in the book.
/wondrous-items:wave: This sentient +3 trident requires worship of a sea god. A critical hit deals extra necrotic damage equal to half the target’s HP maximum. It also functions as a Trident of Fish Command, Weapon of Warning, Cap of Water Breathing while held, and Cube of Force. It urges its wielder to advance sea-god worship.
/wondrous-items:windvane: This finesse spear grants +2 attack and damage and adds 1d6 lightning on a hit. While held, speak Auran, gain lightning resistance and cast Dominate Monster on an air elemental (DC 17) once per dawn. In an air node it can create a devastation orb once per dawn. Attunement imposes an unreliable, oath-breaking flaw.
/wondrous-items:wreath-of-the-prism: Gain darkvision 60 feet, or add 60 feet to existing darkvision. On hitting or grappling an eligible beast, dragon or monstrosity, cast Dominate Monster on it; a successful save grants 24-hour immunity, and charming another ends the first effect. Dormant affects CR 5 or less at DC 13; awakened CR 10 at DC 15; exalted CR 15 at DC 17.
/wondrous-items:akmon: This +3 warhammer adds 3d10 fire on a hit. While held, gain fire resistance, exhaustion immunity, smith’s tools proficiency and advantage on checks using them. Cast each listed spell (DC 18) once per dusk. Worshipers of Purphoros gain random benefits at piety 10, 25 and 50; others incur two minor detrimental properties.
/wondrous-items:bigbys-beneficent-bracel: The bracelet grants Mage Hand and random minor and major benefits plus a minor detriment. Spend 1 minute to create a tangible force copy of a nonmagical object up to Large within 10 feet, lasting 8 hours; three uses recover at dawn. Once per dawn cast Bigby’s Hand at 9th level without concentration, spell attack +13.
/wondrous-items:book-of-exalted-deeds: Only an attuned good creature can open it and gain its benefits after 80 hours of study. Wisdom increases by 2 to a maximum of 24, cleric and paladin spell slots count one level higher, and a dismissible halo protects and aids social checks. An evil reader takes unavoidable 24d6 radiant damage. Benefits end after 10 days without kindness or upon a willing evil act; it also has four random beneficial properties.
/wondrous-items:crook-of-rao: The crook has 6 charges, regains 1d6 at dawn, and casts its listed spells at DC 18. Spend 10 minutes to banish fiends below CR 19 within 1 mile to their home planes for 100 years. Using that power or the last charge triggers a random extraplanar reversal, potentially releasing hostile fiends or destroying the crook and opening Iggwilv’s permanent gate. It has random benefits and a detriment.
/wondrous-items:dekella: This +3 trident deals an extra 2d10 cold on a hit. Once per dusk each, alter sea weather within 1 mile, cast Dominate Monster on a naturally swimming beast or monstrosity, or cast True Polymorph to give a creature a naturally swimming form (DC 18). Thassa worshipers gain piety-based benefits; nonworshipers incur random detrimental properties.
/wondrous-items:eye-and-hand-of-vecna: Attunement requires replacing your eye or left hand with the corresponding artifact; removal kills you and alignment becomes neutral evil. Each has 8 charges, recovers 1d4 + 4 at dawn and casts listed spells (DC 18), with severe risks: the eye may let Vecna consume your soul, and the hand compels evil. Both together grant poison and disease immunity, regeneration, anti-surprise, a lethal touch and Wish once per 30 days. Each also has random properties.
/wondrous-items:iggwilv-s-cauldron: A humanoid attuning risks catastrophic aging on a failed DC 15 Constitution save; only Wish or divine intervention reverses it. Gold form makes food, temporary-HP elixir, a flying broom and a powerful scrying focus. Iron form summons bats, puts humanoids to sleep using blood, creates a limited Wand of Polymorph and can freeze creatures in time. Only Iggwilv or Baba Yaga changes its form. See individual limits and destruction rules.
/wondrous-items:lubas-tarokka-of-souls: The deck casts each listed divination spell once per dawn (DC 18) and ensures concentration saves for divination succeed. Twice per dawn, use an action to grant another visible creature within 15 feet advantage or disadvantage on attacks, checks and saves for 1 hour. Each use risks releasing a hostile soul; until destroyed it gains advantage while you and the target suffer disadvantage. Seven days without using this power ends attunement.
/wondrous-items:mighty-servant-of-leuk-o: Up to two creatures attune inside this piloted construct over 2 hours, risking accidental attacks during attunement. Pilots have total cover and command its movement and actions. It has AC 22, 310 HP, 60-foot speed, regeneration and a +17 fist dealing 4d12 + 10 force. Losing half its HP risks a destructive compulsion (DC 20 Wisdom). Two pilots can initiate a devastating self-destruct; consult the stat block and artifact rules.
/wondrous-items:rod-of-seven-parts: Each broken piece points toward the next and casts its associated spell once per dawn; broken pieces cannot be attuned. The assembled rod is a +3 quarterstaff with 7 charges, regaining 1d4 + 3 at dawn; spend 1 to cast any piece’s spell or cast Detect Evil and Good without charges. It inclines its wielder toward lawful conduct.
/wondrous-items:silken-spite: This sentient rapier grants languages, darkvision, climbing and web mobility. Its poison requires DC 13 Constitution or poisons for 1 hour; failure by 5 also causes unconsciousness. Dormant is +1; awakened is +2 with DC 15 and four spells each once per dawn; exalted is +3, DC 17, sees through magical darkness and teleports between dimly lit spaces once per dawn.
/wondrous-items:sword-of-kas: This sentient +3 longsword critically hits on 19–20 and adds 2d10 slashing against undead. If not bloodied within 1 minute of drawing, a DC 15 Charisma save avoids domination but still deals 3d6 psychic damage. Add 1d10 to initiative and optionally transfer attack bonus to AC when attacking. Cast each listed spell once per dawn (DC 18); random properties apply.
/wondrous-items:the-bloody-end: This sentient morningstar grants Infernal and Intimidation advantage. Dormant is +1 and casts Charm Person, Dominate Person and Fear once each per dawn at DC 13. Awakened is +2, DC 15, adds a once-per-dawn fear burst and 1d6 psychic retaliation. Exalted is +3, DC 17, adds Dominate Monster and increases retaliation to 2d6.
/wondrous-items:will-of-the-talon: This sentient war pick grants Draconic and Infernal. A once-per-dawn bonus action frightens chosen creatures within 30 feet, with repeat saves and later immunity. As an action breathe one of five elemental types, each type recharging at dawn. Dormant is +1, DC 13 and 3d6; awakened +2, DC 15, 4d6 and elemental resistances; exalted +3, DC 17 and 5d6.
/wondrous-items:gnomengarde-grenade: Arm as a bonus action and throw up to 120 feet as an action; it explodes at turn’s end. Creatures within 60 feet make DC 15 Dexterity saves against 8d6 fire and DC 15 Constitution saves against 8d6 thunder and stun until their next turn ends; successful saves halve damage and avoid stun. Roll three distinct Wand of Wonder effects. Teleportation or extradimensional storage detonates it immediately, affecting both ends within 30 feet.
/wondrous-items:orcus-figurine: While intact, undead within 30 feet cannot be turned and dead creatures there cannot be revived. Pray to Orcus while holding it for 1 hour for a 10 percent chance to summon his hostile wraith-like avatar for up to 1 hour; after a successful summon, it cannot recur for 30 days. The figurine has AC 17, 3 HP and immunity to damage except radiant.
/wondrous-items:stonkys-ring: While worn, cast Telekinesis at will, targeting only objects neither worn nor carried. An attuned character controls Stonky’s creations, though skitterwidgets ignore commands from more than 30 feet away.
/wondrous-items:feather-token: Carrying this feather-marked disk protects you after a fall of at least 20 feet: descent slows to 60 feet per round and falling causes no damage. Landing consumes its magic, leaving an ordinary disk.
